20Xizkiya ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛa kple eƒe kalẽwɔwɔ katã, ale si wòɖe ta kple tɔʋu, eye wohe tsi va dua mee la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe “Yuda-fiawo Ŋutinyagbalẽ” la me. 21Xizkiya trɔ megbe yi tɔgbuiawo gbɔ, eye via Manase zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

Title: FIAWO II 21
Content:
Yuda-fia Manase
1Manase dze fiaɖuɖu gɔme esi wòxɔ ƒe wui eve. Eɖu fia ƒe bla atɔ̃ vɔ atɔ̃ le Yerusalem. Nɔa ŋkɔe nye Xefziba. 2Ewɔ nu si nye nuvɔ̃ɖi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, ɖe dukɔ siwo Aƒetɔ nyà ɖa le Israel ŋgɔ la ƒe ŋunyɔnuwo nu. 3Elabe egbugbɔ nuxeƒewo siwo tɔ́a Xizkiya gbã la tu, eɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo na Baal eye wòwɔ nyɔnumawu Asera abe ale si Israel-fia Axab wɔ ene. Ede ta agu na dziƒonuwo katã eye wòsubɔ wo. 4Eɖi vɔsamlekpuiwo ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe, si ŋu Aƒetɔ gblɔ le be: “Yerusalem ye mada nye ŋkɔ ɖo,” la me. 5Eɖi vɔsamlekpui na dziƒonuwo katã ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe ƒe xɔxɔnu eveawo. 6Eme via ŋutsu abe vɔsa ene. Eka afa, sa dzo, ede ha kple ŋɔliyɔlawo kple akunyawɔlawo. Ewɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi geɖe le Aƒetɔ ŋkume tsɔ do dzikui nɛ. 7Etsɔ nyɔnumawu Asera ƒe legba si wòwɔ la da ɖe aƒe si ŋuti Aƒetɔ gblɔ le na David kple via Salomo le be, “Aƒe sia kple Yerusalem si metia le Israel-toawo katã dome la mee mada nye ŋkɔ ɖo tegbee; 8nyemagaɖe mɔ na Israel ƒe aƒe azɔ be woatsa ado go le anyigba si metsɔ na wo tɔgbuiwo la dzi o, nenye be wokpɔ nyuie wɔ se kple ɖoɖo siwo katã mede na wo, eye wowɔ se kple ɖoɖo siwo katã nye dɔla Mose de na wo la dzi.” 9Ke womeɖo to o; Manase ble wo, wowɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi wu dukɔ siwo Aƒetɔ tsrɔ̃ le Israelviwo ŋgɔ. 10Aƒetɔ gblɔ to eƒe dɔla, gbeƒãɖelawo dzi be: 11“Esi Yuda-fia Manase wɔ ŋunyɔnu siawo, eye wòwɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi geɖe wu esiwo katã Amoritɔ siwo do ŋgɔ nɛ la wɔ, eye wòna Yuda hã wɔ nuvɔ̃ kple eƒe legbawo ta la, 12Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: ‘Kpɔ ɖa, mele dzɔgbevɔ̃e he ge ava Yerusalem kple Yuda, anye nu si ƒomevi ame sia ame see la eƒe to me aɖi yeŋ. 13Mada Samaria ƒe dzidzeka kple Axab ƒe aƒe ƒe tsumikpe ɖe Yerusalem ŋu. Matutu Yerusalem abe ale si wotutua nuɖugbae ene, matutui atsɔ bu anyi. 14Matsɔ nye domenyinu la ƒe susɔea aƒu gbe, atsɔ wo ade woƒe futɔwo ƒe asi me, eye woazu nuléle kple nuhaha na woƒe futɔwo katã. 15Elabe wowɔ nu si nye nuvɔ̃ɖi le nye ŋkume hedo dziku nam, tso esime wo tɔgbuiwo do tso Egipte va se ɖe egbe.” 16Gawu la, Manase kɔ ʋu maɖifɔ geɖe ɖi woyɔ Yerusalem tso go ɖeka dzi va se ɖe bubu dzi, hekpe ɖe nuvɔ̃ si wòna Yuda wɔ la ŋu ale be wowɔ nu si vɔ̃ɖi la le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. 17Azɔ Manase ƒe nuwɔna mamlɛawo kple nu siwo katã wòwɔ kpakple nuvɔ̃ si wòwɔ la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe “Yuda-fiawo Ŋutinyagbalẽ” la me. 18Manase trɔ megbe yi tɔgbuiawo gbɔ, eye woɖii ɖe abɔ si nye Uza ƒe abɔ, si le eƒe aƒeme la me.
Yuda-fia Amon
(Kron II, 33.21-25)
19Amon dze fiaɖuɖu gɔme esime wòxɔ ƒe bla eve vɔ eve. Eɖu fia ƒe eve le Yerusalem. Nɔa ŋkɔe enye Mesulemet, Xaruz ƒe vinyɔnu tso Yotba. 20Ewɔ nu si nye nuvɔ̃ɖi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, abe ale si tɔ́a Manase wɔ ene. 21Eto mɔ siwo katã tɔ́a to la dzi, hesubɔ legba siwo tɔ́a subɔ la, eye wode ta agu na wo. 22Egblẽ Aƒetɔ, tɔgbuiawo ƒe Mawu la ɖi, eye mezɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe mɔ dzi o. 23Amon ƒe dɔlawo ɖo nugbe ɖe eŋu, hewu fia la le eƒe aƒeme. 24Ke dukɔ la me tɔwo wu ame siwo katã ɖo nugbe ɖe fia Amon ŋu, eye wotsɔ via Yosiya ɖo fiae ɖe eteƒe. 25Azɔ Amon ƒe nuwɔna mamlɛawo la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe “Yuda-fiawo Ŋutinyagbalẽ” la me. 26Woɖii ɖe eƒe yɔdo me ɖe Uza ƒe abɔ la me. Via Yosiya zu fia ɖe eteƒe.

Title: FIAWO II 22
Content:
Yuda-fia Yosiya
(Kron II, 34.1-2)
1 Yosiya xɔ ƒè enyi esi wòdze fiaɖuɖu gɔme. Eɖu fia ƒe bla etɔ̃ vɔ ɖekɛ le Yerusalem. Nɔa ŋkɔe nye Yesida, Adaya vinyɔnu tso Bozkat. 2Ewɔ nu si nyo le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye wòzɔ tɔgbuia David ƒe mɔwo katã dzi pɛpɛpɛ. Medze ɖe ɖusi alo miame o.
Wofɔ segbalẽ la
(Kron II, 34.8-28)
3Le fia Yosiya ƒe ƒè wui enyilia me la, edɔ agbalẽŋlɔla Safan, Azalya vi ame si nye Mesulam vi ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me be: 4“Yi nunɔlagã Xilkiya gbɔ ne wòaxlẽ ga siwo katã kpuinudzɔlawo dzɔ le dukɔ la si, si wotsɔ va Aƒetɔ ƒeme la. 5Na woatsɔe de asi na dɔnunɔla siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe dɔwo dzi kpɔm la, eye woawo natsɔe na dɔwɔla siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la dzram ɖo la. 6Woawoe nye atikpalawo, xɔtulawo kple gliɖolawo, be woaƒle atiwo kple kpe gbagbãwo, adzra Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ɖoe. 7Ke womabia akɔnta aɖeke tso wo si tso ga si wotsɔ de wo si la ŋu o, elabe wotoa nyateƒe le woƒe dɔwɔwɔ me.”
8Nunɔlagã Xilkiya gblɔ na agbalẽŋlɔla Safan be: “Mefɔ segbalẽ aɖe le Aƒetɔ ƒeme.” Esi Xilkiya tsɔ agbalẽ la na Safan la, exlẽe. 9Agbalẽŋlɔla, Safan va fia la gbɔ xɔ gbe vɛ na fia la be: “Wò dɔlawo trɔ ga si wokpɔ le aƒe la me, eye wotsɔe de asi na dɔnunɔla siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la dzi kpɔm.” 10Tete agbalẽŋlɔla Safan gblɔ na fia la be: “Nunɔla Xilkiya tsɔ agbalẽ aɖe nam.” Safan xlẽe na fia la.
11Esime fia la se segbalẽa me nyawo la, edze eƒe awuwo. 12Fia la ɖe gbe na nunɔla Xilkiya, Safan vi Axikam, Mixaya vi Axbor, agbalẽŋlɔla Safan, kple fia ƒe subɔla Asaya be: 13“Miyi ɖabia gbe Aƒetɔ na nye kple dukɔ la kpakple Yuda katã ku ɖe agbalẽ si wofɔ la ƒe nyawo ŋuti. Elabe Aƒetɔ do dɔmedzoe gã ŋutɔ ɖe mía ŋu, elabe mía tɔgbuiwo meɖo to agbalẽ sia ƒe nyawo ne woawɔ ɖe nu siwo woŋlɔ ɖe eme, woka mi la dzi o.”
14Ale nunɔla Xilkiya, Axikam, Axbor, Safan kple Asaya woyi nyɔnugbeƒãɖela Hulda Salum, Xarxas vi si nye awudzikpɔla srɔ̃ gbɔ. Azɔ enɔ Yerusalem ƒe to evelia. Woƒo nu kplii. 15Egblɔ na wo be: “Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la be: ‘Migblɔ na ŋutsu si dɔ mi ɖe gbɔnye la be: 16Aƒetɔ be, Kpɔ da, mele dzɔgbevɔ̃e he ge ava teƒe sia kple emenɔlawo dzi ɖe agbalẽ sia me nya, siwo katã Yuda-fia xlẽ la nu. 17Elabe wogbe nu le gbɔnye, eye wotɔ dzo lifi na mawu tutɔwo, be woatsɔ do dziku nam kple woƒe asinudɔwɔwɔwo katã. Eya ta nye dɔmedzoe abi ɖe teƒe sia ŋu, eye womatsii o. 18Ke le Yuda-fia si dɔ mi be miaɖabia gbe Aƒetɔ gome la, migblɔ nɛ be, Aƒetɔ Israel ƒe Mawu la be: Ku ɖe nya siwo nèxlẽ ŋu la, 19esi nètrɔ dzime, eye nèbɔbɔ ɖokuiwò le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, esi nèse ale si megblɔ ɖe teƒe sia kple emenɔlawo ŋuti, be woazu aƒedo kple fiƒode, eye nèdze wò awuwo hefa avi le ŋkunye me ta la, nye hã mese wò nya, Aƒetɔ lae gblɔe. 20Eya ta, kpɔ ɖa, mana nàyi tɔgbuiawòwo gbɔ, eye woaɖi wò ɖe wò yɔdo me le ŋutifafa me, eye wò ŋkuwo makpɔ dzɔgbevɔ̃e siwo katã hege mala ava teƒe sia dzi la o.” Wova bɔ amaniɛa na fia la.

Title: FIAWO II 23
Content:
1Tete fia la dɔ ame be woaƒo ƒu Yuda kple Yerusalem ƒe ame tsitsiwo katã ɖe ye gbɔ. 2Eyi Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me, eye Yudatɔwo kple Yerusalemnɔlawo katã kpe ɖe eŋu: nunɔlawo, Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖelawo, dukɔmetɔwo katã tim ko, ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo siaa. Tete fia la xlẽ nubabla ƒe agbalẽ si wofɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me la me nyawo na wo katã. 3Azɔ fia la tsi tsitre ɖe enɔƒe le sɔti la gbɔ, eye wòbla nu kple Aƒetɔ be yeanɔ eyome, alé eƒe sewo, sededewo kple ɖoɖowo me ɖe asi tso dzi blibo kple luʋɔ blibo me, eye yeawɔ nya siwo katã woŋlɔ ɖe nubabla ƒe agbalẽa me la dzi. Dukɔ blibo la lɔ̃ ɖe nubabla la dzi.
4 Azɔ Yosiya ɖe gbe na nunɔlagã Xilkiya kple nunɔla siwo va ɖe eyome kpakple Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe mɔnudzɔlawo be woafɔ nu siwo katã ŋudɔ wowɔna subɔa Baal kple nyɔnumawu Asera kpakple dziŋgɔli me nuwo katã la do goe le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me. Etɔ dzo nuawo keŋ le Yerusalem godo le Kidron-bali me, eye wòlɔ afi la yi Betel. 5Eɖe nunɔla siwo Yuda-fiawo ɖo be woasa vɔ le nuxeƒewo le Yuda-duwo kple Yerusalem-nutowo me la ɖa. Egaɖe esiwo tɔa dzo lifi na Baal, ɣe, ɣleti kple ɣletiviwo kpakple dziŋgɔli me nuwo katã hã ɖa. 6Yosiya ɖe nyɔnumawu Asera ƒe legba la ɖa tso Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me tsɔ yi Kidron-tɔʋu la nu le Yerusalem godo ɖatɔ dzoe ɖe afi ma. Etui memie, eye wòlɔe ɖawú ɖe ame tsɛwo ƒe yɔdowo dzi. 7Emu ŋutsu nuxeƒegbolowɔxɔ siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me, afi si nyɔnuwo lɔ̃a avɔ na nyɔnumawu, Asera le la. 8Ena nunɔlawo katã tso Yuda-duwo me va, eye wòdo gu nuxeƒe siwo nunɔlawo saa vɔ le tso Geba va se ɖe Beer-Seba la. Egbã agbonunuxeƒe siwo le dumegã Yosua ƒe agbo nu le dugboa ƒe miame lɔƒo la. 9Ke nunɔla siwo le nuxeƒewo la mevaa Aƒetɔ ƒe vɔsamlekpui si le Yerusalem la gbɔ o, ke boŋ woɖua abolo maʋamaʋã kple wo nɔviwo ya. 10 Fia la do gu Tofet-nuxeƒe si le Ben-Him-balia me ale be ame aɖeke magatsɔ via ŋutsu alo via nyɔnu asa vɔ le dzo me na Molex azɔ o. 11Eɖe sɔ siwo ŋu Yuda-fiawo kɔ̀ hena ɣesubɔsubɔ la ɖa, eye wòtɔ dzo ɣetasiaɖamwo. Wotsɔ nu siawo da ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnu le agboa nu lɔƒo, eye teƒe sia medidi tso xɔ si me Natan-Melex aƒemenudzikpɔla nɔna la gbɔ o. 12 Fia la ɖe vɔsamlekpui siwo le Axaz ƒe xɔta siwo Yuda-fiawo ɖi la kple esiwo Manase hã ɖi ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe xɔxɔnu eveawo la hã ɖa. Egbã wo gudugudu lɔ ɖaƒu gbe ɖe Kidron-tɔʋu me. 13 Fia Yosiya do gu nuxeƒe siwo le Yerusalem ƒe ɣedzeƒe le Amito la ƒe anyigbeme. Vɔsamlekpui siawo nye ŋunyɔnu siwo Israel-fia Salomo ɖi na Astarte, Kemos Sidontɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnu, Moabitɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnu kple Milkom, Amontɔwo ƒe ŋunyɔnu. 14Yosiya gbã aƒeliwo, mu nyɔnumawu Asera ŋu nuwo ƒu anyi, eye wòlɔ ameƒuwo kɔ ɖe wo teƒewo. 15 Nenema ke wòɖe vɔsamlekpui si le Betel kple nuxeƒe si Yerobeam, Nebat vi ɖi tsɔ na Israel wɔ nuvɔ̃ la ɖa. Egbã vɔsamlekpui la kple nuxeƒe la, tɔ dzo nuxeƒea, eye wòtui memie. Etɔ dzo Asera la hã. 16 Yosiya tsa ŋku, eye wòkpɔ yɔdo aɖewo le to dzi ɖa. Ena woyi ɖalɔ ƒuwo le wo me vɛ nɛ, eye wòtɔ dzo wo le vɔsamlekpui la dzi. Ale wòdo gu vɔsamlekpui la le Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si gbeƒãɖela gblɔ ɖi la nu gbe aɖe gbe le ŋkekenyui ɖuƒe, esime fia Yerobeam le tsitre ɖe vɔsamlekpui gbɔ. Yosiya nye kɔ kpɔ Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela si gblɔ nya siawo ɖi la ƒe yɔdo. 17 Tete wò bia be: “Ŋkuɖodzikpe kae nye ekema kpɔm mele?” Dua me tɔwo ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela si tso Yuda va ɖe gbeƒã nu si nèwɔ ɖe vɔsamlekpuia ŋu le Betel la ƒe yɔdoe.” 18Azɔ egblɔ be: “Miɖe asi le eŋu; ame aɖeke megaka asi eƒe ƒuwo ŋu o.” Ale womeka asi eya kple Mawu ƒe gbeƒãɖela si tso Samaria la ƒe ƒuwo ŋu o. 19Gawu la, Yosiya kaka trɔ̃xɔ siwo katã le nuxeƒewo le Samaria-duwo me la. Xɔ siawoe Israel-fiawo tu tsɔ do dziku na Aƒetɔ. Yosiya wɔ wo abe ale si wòwɔ esiwo nɔ Betel la ene. 20Ewu nunɔla siwo katã le nuxeƒea le afi ma la ɖe vɔsamlekpuiawo dzi, eye wòtɔ dzo ameƒuwo le wo dzi hã. Emegbe egbugbɔ va Yerusalem.
Yosiya ɖu Paska la
(Kron II, 35.1-19)
21Fia la bia tso dukɔ blibo la si be: “Miɖu Paska la na Aƒetɔ, miaƒe Mawu la abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe nubabla ƒe agbalẽ sia me la ene.” 22Womeɖu Paska aɖeke le Israel-ɖelawo ŋɔli alo le Israel kple Yuda fiawo ŋɔli nenema kpɔ o. 23Ke azɔ ko le Yosiya ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui enyilia me woɖu Paska la na Aƒetɔ le Yerusalem.
Tɔtrɔ bubu siwo Yosiya he vɛ
(Kron II, 35.1-19)
24Gawu la, Yosiya di be dukɔa nawɔ nya siwo woŋlɔ ɖe agbalẽ si nunɔla Xilkiya fɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me la dzi, eya ta eɖe ŋɔliyɔlawo, adzetɔwo aklama kpakpɛwo, legbawo kple ŋunyɔnu siwo katã wòkpɔ le Yuda-nyigba dzi kple Yerusalem la ɖa. 25Fia aɖeke meɖu fia do ŋgɔ nɛ, si subɔ Aƒetɔ le Mose ƒe seawo katã nu kple eƒe dzi blibo, eƒe luʋɔ blibo kple eƒe ŋusẽ katã abe eya ene o. Fia aɖeke hã megava ɖe eyome abe eya ene o. 26Gake dɔmedzoe gã si fia Manase do na Aƒetɔ la gale dɔ me nɛ kokoko ɖe Yuda ŋuti. 27Eya ta Aƒetɔ be: “Maɖe Yuda hã ɖa le nye ŋku ta abe ale si meɖe Israel ɖa ene. Nye ŋutɔe tia Yerusalem-du sia, gake magbee, eye magbe aƒe si ŋu megblɔ le be: ‘Nye ŋkɔ anɔ afi ma’ la hã.”
Yosiya ƒe fiaɖuɖu wu nu
(Kron II, 35.20—36.1)
28Yosiya ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛa kple nu siwo katã wòwɔ la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe “Yuda-fiawo Ŋutinyagbalẽ” la me. 29Le Yosiya ŋɔli la, Egipte Fiagã Nexo ho kple eƒe aʋakɔ ɖe Asiria-fia ŋu le Frat-tɔsisi nu. Fia Yosiya ho ɖakpee, gake esi wodo go le Megido la, Nexo wui. 30Eƒe dɔlawo tsɔ eƒe kukua ɖe tasiaɖam me tso Megido va Yerusalem, eye woɖii ɖe eya ŋutɔ ƒe yɔdo me. Dukɔa me tɔwo si ami na via Yoaxaz heɖoe fiae ɖe tɔ́a teƒe.
Yoaxaz zu fia le Yuda
(Kron II, 36.2-4)
31Yoaxaz xɔ ƒe bla eve vɔ etɔ̃ esime wòva zu fia. Eɖu fia le Yerusalem ɣleti etɔ̃. Nɔa tso Libna. Eŋkɔ nye Xamutal, Yeremya vinyɔnu. 32Ewɔ nuvɔ̃ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume abe ale si tɔgbuiawo wɔ ene. 33Eva eme be Egipte Fiagã Nexo lé Yoaxaz de gaxɔ me ɖe Ribla le Xamat-nyigba dzi be magaɖu fia le Yerusalem o. Azɔ ezi Yuda dzi be wòadzɔ klosalo kilo akpe etɔ̃ alafa ene kple sika kilo bla etɔ̃ vɔ ene na ye. 34 Nexo tsɔ Elyakim, Yosiya vi ɖo fia ɖe tɔ́a Yosiya teƒe hetrɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Yehoyakim. Ke ekplɔ Yoaxaz ya yi Egipte, afi si wòku le.
Yehoyakim zu fia le Yuda
(Kron II, 36.5-8)
35Yehoyakim dzɔ klosalo kple sika si Egipte Fiagã Nexo bia tso esi la. Ena dukɔmevi ɖe sia ɖe dzɔe ɖe eƒe ŋutete nu wòtsɔ yi ɖade asi na Egipte Fiagã la.
36 Yehoyakim xɔ ƒe bla eve vɔ etɔ̃ esime wòzu fia le Yerusalem. Eɖu fia le Yerusalem ƒe wuiɖekɛ. Nɔa tso Ruma. Eŋkɔe nye Zebuda, Padaya vinyɔnu. 37Ewɔ nuvɔ̃ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume abe ale si tɔgbuiawo katã wɔ ene.

Title: FIAWO II 24
Content:
1 Esime Yehoyakim nye fia la, Babilonia-fia Nebukadnezar ho va, eye wòzi Yehoyakim dzi wònɔ ete ƒe etɔ̃; emegbe etrɔ dze aglã ɖe Nebukadnezar ŋu. 2Ale Aƒetɔ na adzohawo tso Kaldea, Moab, Siria kple Amon va Yuda be woatsrɔ̃e le Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si wògblɔ to eƒe dɔla gbeƒãɖelawo dzi la nu. 3Aƒetɔ ŋutɔe ɖe gbe be woawɔ Yuda alea, ne wòadzo le yeƒe ŋku ta le nuvɔ̃ siwo katã fia Manase wɔ la ta, 4hekpe ɖe ame maɖifɔ ƒe ʋu si wòkɔ ɖi, eye wòyɔ Yerusalem taŋ la ŋuti. Aƒetɔ medi be yeatsɔe ake o. 5Yehoyakim ƒe ŋutinya mamlɛa kple nu siwo katã wòwɔ la, woŋlɔ wo ɖe “Yuda-fiawo Ŋutinyagbalẽ” la me. 6Yehoyakim ku, eye via Yehoyakin zu fia ɖe eteƒe. 7Ke Egipte-fia megaho tso Egipte-nyigba dzi kpɔ o, elabe Babilonia-fia xɔ anyigba siwo katã nye Egipte-fia tɔ la le esi, tso Egipte-tɔʋu la nu le dzigbeme va se ɖe Frat nu.
Yehoyakin zu fia le Yuda
(Kron II, 36.9-10)
8Yehoyakin xɔ ƒe wui enyi esime wòzu fia. Eɖu fia le Yerusalem ɣleti etɔ̃. Nɔa tso Yerusalem. Eŋkɔ nye Nexusta, Elnatan vinyɔnu. 9Ewɔ nuvɔ̃ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume abe ale si tɔ́a wɔ ene.
10Ɣe ma ɣi la Babilonia-fia Nebukadnezar na eƒe aʋakɔwo tso ɖe Yerusalem ŋu, eye woɖe to ɖee. 11Le ɣeyiɣi sia me la, Babilonia-fia Nebukadnezar ŋutɔ va ɖo dua ƒe agbo nu esime eƒe dɔlawo ɖe to ɖee. 12Tete Yehoyakin na ta eye eya ŋutɔ, nɔa, eƒe subɔlawo, eƒe amegãwo kple fiasãmenudzikpɔlawo katã tsɔ wo ɖokui na Nebukadnezar. Ale Babilonia-fia ɖe aboyoe le eƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè enyilia me. 13Elɔ kesinɔnu siwo katã le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me kple fiasã la me la dzoe, eye wògbã sikanu siwo katã Israel-fia Salomo wɔ ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me la. Nebukadnezar wɔ esiawo katã le Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si wògblɔ ɖi la nu. 14Eɖe aboyo Yerusalem blibo la katã, amegãwo kple aʋawɔlawo katã, wole ame akpe ewo, hekpe ɖe aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo kple nutulawo ŋu. Megblẽ ame aɖeke ɖe dua me o, negbe ame siwo da ahe ŋutɔŋutɔ la ko. 15Yehoyakin yi Babilonia. Fia nɔ, fia srɔ̃wo, fiasãmenuwo dzikpɔlawo kple bubumewo katã tso Yerusalem kpe ɖe eŋu yi. 16Ekplɔ aʋawɔla akpe adrẽ, aɖaŋudɔwɔla kple nutula akpe ɖeka, siwo nye ame sesẽwo ate ŋu awɔ aʋa la yi Babilonia. 17 Babilonia-fia tsɔ Matanya Yehoyakin tɔɖea, ɖo fiae ɖe Yehoyakin teƒe, eye wòtrɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Zedekiya.
Zedekiya zu fia le Yuda
(Kron II, 36.11-12; Yer 52.1-3a)
18 Zedekiya xɔ ƒe bla eve vɔ ɖekɛ esime wòzu fia. Eɖu fia le Yerusalem ƒe wuiɖekɛ. Nɔa tso Libna. Eŋkɔ nye Xamutal, Yeremya vinyɔnu. 19Ewɔ nuvɔ̃ le Aƒetɔ ŋkume abe ale si Yehoyakim wɔ ene. 20 Eva eme na Yerusalem kple Yuda alea, elabe wodo dziku na Aƒetɔ ale gbegbe be wòɖe wo ɖa le eƒe ŋku ta.

Title: FIAWO II 25
Content:
Wogbã Yerusalem
(Kron II, 36.13-21; Yer 52.3b-11)
1 Fia Zedekiya va dze aglã ɖe Babilonia-fia ŋu. Le Zedekiya ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè asiekelia me, le ɣleti ewolia ƒe ŋkeke ewolia gbe la, Babilonia-fia Nebukadnezar kple eƒe aʋakɔ katã ho va Yerusalem. Woɖe to ɖe dua, eye woƒu kpo ɖe eŋu godoo va kpe. 2Woɖe to ɖe dua alea va se ɖe Zedekiya ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui ɖekɛlia me. 3Le ɣleti enelia ƒe ŋkeke asiekelia gbe le ƒe ma me la, dɔwuame nu sẽ le dua me ale gbegbe be ame aɖeke mekpɔ naneke ɖu o. 4 Togbɔ be Babiloniatɔwo ƒo xlã dua hã la, woŋɔ dugli la, eye fia la kple eƒe aʋawɔlawo katã sí le zã me to agbo si le gli eveawo dome le fia ƒe abɔ gbɔ lɔƒo la heɖo ta Yordan-gbegbe la. 5Ke Babiloniatɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ti fia la yome ɖatui le Yerixo-gbegbe. Eƒe aʋakɔ blibo la ka hlẽ, gblẽe ɖi. 6Ale wolé fia la, kplɔe va Babilonia-fia gbɔ le Ribla, eye wòdrɔ̃ ʋɔnui. 7 Wowu Zedekiya viŋutsuwo le eŋkume. Eyome wogbã Zedekiya ƒe ŋkuwo, de gae hekplɔe yi Babilonia.
Wogbã Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la
(Yer 52.12-23)
8Le ɣleti etɔ̃lia ƒe ŋkeke adrẽlia gbe, si nye Babilonia-fia Nebukadnezar ƒe fiaɖuɖu ƒe ƒè wui asiekelia me la, Nebuzaradan, fia ŋu srafowo ƒe tatɔ si nye Babilonia-fia ƒe dɔla la va Yerusalem. 9Etɔ dzo Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la, fiasã la kple Yerusalem-xɔwo katã; etɔ dzo xɔ gãwo katã. 10Babilonia-srafo siwo katã le woƒe tatɔa ŋu la gbã dugli siwo katã ƒo xlã Yerusalem va kpe ɖo la. 11Nebuzaradan, fia ŋu srafowo ƒe tatɔ kplɔ ame mamlɛ siawo yi aboyo mee: ame siwo tsi dua me, ame siwo na ta Babilonia-fia kple ame haho la. 12Gake egblẽ ame siwo da ahe ŋutɔŋutɔ la ya ɖi be woade waingble kple agble bubuwo. 13Babiloniatɔwo mu akɔblisɔti siwo le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me, eye wògbã anyinɔawo kple akɔbligazɔ si le afi ma la hã, eye wolɔ akɔblia yi Babilonia. 14 Wotsɔ zeawo, sofiawo, akaɖitsinuawo kple agba siwo me wotɔa dzo lifi le la kpakple akɔblinuawo, siwo katã ŋudɔ wowɔna le subɔsubɔ me la hã dzoe. 15Fia ŋu srafowo ƒe tatɔ la tsɔ dzoɖenuawo kple agba bubuawo kpakple nu sia nu si wotsɔ sika alo klosalo wɔ la siaa dzoe. 16Nu siwo fia Salomo tsɔ akɔbli wɔ da ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me siwo nye sɔti eve, gazɔ ɖeka kple anyinɔawo ƒe akɔbli la womate ŋu ada wo le nudanu me o. 17Sɔti si kɔ meta enyi, eye ta si wowɔ kple akɔbli ɖo eta me la kɔ abe meta ɖeka kple afã ene. Wowɔ gaɖɔ kple yevuboɖawo ɖe ta la ŋu godoo va kpe. Sɔti evelia hã le nenema ke.
Wokplɔ Yuda-dukɔmetɔwo yi aboyo me
(Yer 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
18Fia ŋu srafowo ƒe tatɔ lé nunɔlagã Seraya kple nunɔla si va ɖe eyome, Zefanya kple Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la ƒe mɔnudzɔla etɔ̃awo. 19Le dua me la, elé asrafomegã si kpɔa aʋawɔlawo dzi, fia ƒe aɖaŋuɖola atɔ̃, siwo gale dua me ko, agbalẽŋlɔla, ame si nye aʋakpɔla si tiaa dukɔmeviwo dea aʋakɔ me kple dukɔmetɔ bubu bla ade siwo wòkpɔ le dua me. 20Nebuzaradan, fia ŋu srafowo ƒe tatɔ la, lé ame siawo katã, kplɔ vɛ na Babilonia-fia la le Ribla. 21Babilonia-fia la ƒo wo eye wòwu wo le Ribla le Xamat-nyigba dzi. Ale wokplɔ Yuda yi aboyo me tso wo denyigba dzi.
Wotsɔ Gedalya ɖo mɔ́mefia le Yuda
(Yer 40.7-9; 41.1-3)
22 Babilonia-fia Nebukadnezar tsɔ Gedalya, Axikam vi, Safan vi ɖo ame siwo tsi Yuda-nyigba dzi la nu. 23Azɔ esi Yuda-srafowo ƒe tatɔwo kple woƒe asrafowo, se be wotsɔ Gedalya ɖo mɔ́mefiae le Yuda la, woyi egbɔ le Mizpa. Woawoe nye: Ismael, Netanya vi, Yehohanan, Kareax vi kple Saraya, Tanxumet vi tso Netofa kpakple Yaazanya, Maaxati vi, hekpe ɖe woƒe asrafowo ŋu. 24Tete Gedalya ka atam na tatɔawo kple woƒe asrafoawo be: “Migavɔ̃ Babiloniatɔwo ƒe dɔlawo o. Minɔ anyigba la dzi, eye misubɔ Babilonia-fia, ekema nu sia nu adze dzi na mi.” 25Ke le ɣleti adrẽlia me la, Ismael, Netanya vi, Elisama vi si tso fiaƒome la me la va kple ŋutsu ewo. Wowu Gedalya, Yudatɔ kple Babiloniatɔ siwo le eŋu le Mizpa. 26Tete dukɔmetɔwo katã, ɖeviwo kple tsitsiawo siaa hekpe ɖe asrafowo ƒe tatɔwo ŋu dzo yi Egipte elabe wole Babiloniatɔwo vɔ̃m.
Woɖe Yehoyakin tso gaxɔ me
(Yer 52.31-34)
27Le Yuda-fia Yehoyakin ƒe aboyo me nɔnɔ ƒe ƒè bla etɔ̃ vɔ adrẽlia me la, Babilonia-fia Evil-Merodax zu fia, eye wòve Yehoyakin nu ɖee tso gaxɔ me le ƒe ma ƒe ɣleti wui evelia ƒe ŋkeke bla eve vɔ adrẽa gbe. 28Babilonia-fia ƒo nu kplii lɔlɔ̃tɔe eye wòna nɔƒe kɔkɔtɔe ɖe eɖokui gbɔ le fia bubu siwo le eŋu le Babilonia la dome. 29Ale ena Yehoyakin ɖe eƒe gaxɔmenɔwuwo ɖi, eye wòɖua nu le fia gbɔ ɣe sia ɣi le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me. 30Fia kpɔa eƒe gbe sia gbe nuhiahiãwo gbɔ. Enaa kotokumegae gbe sia gbe le eƒe agbe me ŋkekewo katã me.

Title: KRONIKA I KPƆKPLƆYIÐEME
Content:
KPƆKPLƆYIÐEME
Kronika ƒe Agbalẽ Gbãtɔ nye nyadzɔdzɔ siwo le Samuel kple Fiawo ƒe agbalẽawo me la ŋɔŋlɔ to mɔ bubu nu. Mawu gɔmesese ƒe susu tɔxɛ evee nye gɔmeɖokpe na Israel-fiaɖuƒe ƒe ŋutinya siwo wode dzesii ɖe Kronika ƒe agbalẽawo me.
Gbãtɔe nye be, togbɔ be Israelviwo kple woƒe fiawo he dzɔgbevɔ̃e kple tohehe geɖe va wo ɖokui dzii hã la, Mawu ya wɔa eƒe ŋugbedodowo dzi kplikpaa, eye wòna be eƒe tameɖoɖo va eme na eƒe dukɔ la. Esia dzé le nu gã siwo David kple Salomo wɔ kple ɖɔɖɔɖo siwo Yosafat, Xizkiya kple Yosiya wɔ la me. Ale Israelvi aɖewo ya wɔ nuteƒe na Mawu. Susu evelia nye be Yerusalem gbedoxɔ la me mawusubɔsubɔ kple ɖoɖo siwo wowɔ na nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo la le vevie. Wole kpe ɖom edzi le ŋutinya siawo me be David ye ɖo gbedoxɔa kple eme subɔsubɔkɔnuwo anyi, togbɔ be via Salomo ye va tu xɔa hã.
Agbalẽa me nyatiwo
Dzidzimewo kple ƒomeawo xexlẽfia 1.1—9.44
Fia Saul ƒe ku 10.1-14
Fia David ƒe fiaɖuɖu 11.1—29.30
a. David zu fia 11.1—12.40
b. Eƒe fukpekpewo kple nu gã siwo wòwɔ 13.1—22.1
d. Dzadzraɖo na gbedoxɔ la tutu 22.2—29.30

Title: KRONIKA I 1
Content:
Tso Adam dzi va se ɖe Abraham dzi
(Mos I, 5.1-32; 10.1-32; 11.10-26)
1Adam, Set, Enos; 2Kenan, Mahalalel, Yared; 3Henox, Metusala, Lamex; 4Noa, Sem, Xam, Yafet.
5Yafet viŋutsuwoe nye: Gomer, Magɔg, Madai, Yavan, Tubal, Mesex kple Tiras. 6Gomer viŋutsuwoe nye: Askenaz, Difat kple Togarma. 7Yavan viŋutsuwoe nye: Elisa, Tarsis, Kititɔwo kple Rodantɔwo.
8Xam viŋutsuwoe nye: Nubiatɔwo, Egiptetɔwo, Putitɔwo kple Kanaantɔwo. 9Nubia viŋutsuwoe nye: Seba, Xavila, Sabta, Raama kple Sabtexa: Raama viŋutsuwoe nye Seba kple Dedan. 10Nubia nye Nimrod tɔ́a. Eyae nye kalẽtɔ gbãtɔ le anyigba dzi.
11Egiptetɔwo mee Ludtɔwo, Anamitɔwo, Lehabitɔwo, Naftuxitɔwo, 12Patrusitɔwo kple Kasluxitɔwo dzɔ tso. Woawo ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Filistitɔwo kple Kaftoritɔwo.
13Kanaan ƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye Sidon, eye eyometɔwoe nye Xet. 14Yebusitɔwo, Amoritɔwo, Girgasitɔwo, 15Xivitɔwo, Arkitɔwo, Sinitɔwo, 16Arvaditɔwo, Zemaritɔwo kple Xamatitɔwo.
17Sem viŋutsuwoe nye: Elam, Asur, Arpaxsad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Xul, Geter kple Mesex. 18Arpaxsad vie nye Selax, ame si dzi Eber. 19Wodzi viŋutsuvi eve na Eber, ɖekae nye Peleg elabe wodzii le anyigbamaɣi; nɔviae nye Yoktan. 20Yoktan viŋutsuwoe nye: Almodad, Sale, Xazarmave, Yarax, 21Xadoram, Uzal, Dikla, 22Ebal, Abimael, Seba, 23Ofir, Xavila kple Yobab.
24Sem, Arpaxsad, Selax, 25Eber, Peleg, Regu, 26Serug, Naxor, Tarax kple 27Abram, ame si va zu Abraham.
Ismael kple Ketura ƒe dzidzimeviwo
(Mos I, 25.12-16)
28Abraham viŋutsuwo nye Isak kple Ismael. 29Woƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye esi: Ismael ƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye Nebayot. Eyometɔe nye Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam, 30Misma, Duma, Masa, Xadad, Tema, 31Yetur, Nafis kple Kedma. Ame siawoe nye Ismael viŋutsuwo.
32Abraham ƒe ahiãvi Ketura, viŋutsuwoe nye: Edzi Zimran, Yoksan, Medan, Midian, Yisbak kple Suax. Yoksan viŋutsuwoe nye Seba kple Dedan. 33Midian viŋutsuwoe nye: Efa, Efer, Xanox, Abida kple Eldaa. Ame siawo katã nye Ketura ƒe dzidzimeviwo.
Esau ƒe dzidzimeviwo
(Mos I, 36.1-19)
34Abraham nye Isak tɔ́a. Isak viŋutsuwoe nye Esau kple Israel. 35Esau viŋutsuwoe nye: Elifaz, Reguel, Yehus, Yaelam kple Korax. 36Elifaz viŋutsuwoe nye: Teman, Omar, Zefi, Gaetam, Kenaz, Timna kple Amalek. 37Reguel viwoe nye: Naxat, Zerax, Sama kple Miza.
Seir kple Edomtɔwo
(Mos I, 36.20-30)
38Seir viŋutsuwoe nye: Lotan, Sobal, Zibeon, Ana, Dison, Ezer kple Disan. 39Lotan viŋutsuwoe nye Xori kple Homan ƒe towo. Lotan nɔvinyɔnu nye Timna. 40Sobal viŋutsuwoe nye: Alyan, Manaxat, Ebal, Sefi kple Onam. Zibeon viŋutsuwoe nye Aya kple Ana ƒe towo. 41Ana vie nye Dison, eye Dison viŋutsuwoe nye: Xamran, Esban, Yitran kple Xeran ƒe towo. 42Ezer viŋutsuwoe nye: Bilhan, Zaavan kple Yaakan. Disan viŋutsuwoe nye Uz kple Aran.
Edom-fiawo
(Mos I, 36.31-43)
43Fia siwo ɖu Edom-nyigba dzi hafi fia aɖe naɖu fia le Israel la woe nye: Bela, Beor vi, ame si ƒe fiadue nye Dinhaba. 44Esi Bela ku la, Yobab, Zerax vi, tso Bozra ɖu fia ɖe eteƒe. 45Esi Yobab ku la, Xusam si tso Temantɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi la zu fia ɖe eteƒe. 46Esi Xusam ku la, Hadad, Bedad vi, zu fia ɖe eteƒe. Eyae ɖu Midiantɔwo dzi le Moab-tagba. Eƒe fiadue nye Avit. 47Esi Hadad ku la, Samla tso Masreka ɖu fia ɖe eteƒe.
48Esi Samla ku la, Saul tso Rexobot le tɔsisi la nu zu fia ɖe eteƒe.
49Esi Saul ku la, Baal-Xanan, si nye Axbor vi, zu fia ɖe eteƒe. 50Esi Baal-Xanan ku la, Hadad zu fia ɖe eteƒe. Eƒe fiadue nye Pagi. Srɔ̃a Mahatabeel nye Matred vinyɔnu kple Masaxab ƒe mamayɔvi. 51Le Hadad ƒe ku megbe la, Edom-fiawoe nye: Timna, Alva, Yetet, 52Oholibama, Ela, Pinon, 53Kenaz, Teman, Mibzar, 54Magdiel kple Iram. Ame siawoe nye Edom-fiawo.

Title: KRONIKA I 2
Content:
Yuda ƒe dzidzimeviwo
1Israel viŋutsuwoe nye esiawo: Ruben, Simeon, Levi, Yuda, Isaxar, Zebulon, 2Dan, Yosef, Benyamin, Naftali, Gad kple Aser. 3Yuda viŋutsuwoe nye: Ger, Onan kple Sela; Sua vinyɔnu si tso Kanaan lae dzi wo nɛ. Ger, Yuda ƒe ŋgɔgbevi wɔ nuvɔ̃ɖi le Aƒetɔ ŋkume, ale wòwui. 4Tamar, ame si nye Yuda toyɔvi la hã dzi Perez kple Zerax nɛ. Ale Yuda viŋutsuwoe katã le atɔ̃.
5Perez viŋutsuwoe nye: Xezron kple Xamul. 6Zerax viŋutsuwoe nye: Zimri, Etan, Heman, Xalkol kple Dara; wo katã le atɔ̃. 7Karmi viŋutsuwoe nye Axan, ame si he dzɔgbevɔ̃e va Israel-dukɔ la dzi, le esi wòtsɔ busunuawo ƒe ɖe ta. 8Etan viŋutsue nye Azarya.
David ƒe ƒome
9Xezron viŋutsu siwo wodzi nɛ la woe nye: Yeraxmeel, Ram kple Kalubai.
10Ram nye Aminadab tɔ́a eye Aminadab nye Naxeson tɔ́a, ame si nye Yuda viwo ƒe ƒometatɔ. 11Naxeson nye Salma tɔ́a eye Salma nye Boaz tɔ́a. 12Boaz nye Obed tɔ́a eye Obed nye Yese tɔ́a. 13Yese nye eƒe ŋgɔgbevi Eliab tɔ́a; eyometɔe nye Abinadab, etɔ̃liae nye Simea. 14Eneliae nye Netaneel, atɔ̃lia nye Radai. 15Adeliae nye Ozem eye adrẽliae nye David. 16Wo nɔvinyɔnuwoe nye Zeruya kple Abigail. Zeruya viŋutsuwoe nye: Abisai, Yoab kple Asahel, wole ame etɔ̃. 17Abigail dzi Amasa, eye Amasa tɔ́a nye Yeter, Ismaeltɔ la.
Xezron ƒe dzidzimeviwo
18Kaleb, Xezron vi, dzi vi kple srɔ̃a Azuba kpakple Yeriot. Via ŋutsuwoe nye: Yeser, Sobab kple Ardon. 19Esi Azuba ku la, Kaleb ɖe Efrat eye wòdzi Xur nɛ. 20Xur nye Uri tɔ́a, eye Uri nye Bezaleel tɔ́a.
21Esi Xezron xɔ ƒe bla ade la, ede asi Maxir, ame si nye Gileadtɔ la nɔvinyɔnu ŋu, eye wòxɔe ɖe. Edzi Segub nɛ. 22Segub nye Yair tɔ́a, ame si si du bla eve vɔ etɔ̃ nɔ le Gilead-nyigba dzi. 23Ke Gesuritɔwo kple Aramtɔwo va xɔ Yair-kɔƒeawo kple Kenat kpakple eŋu kɔƒewo. Wole du bla ade. Ame siawo katã nye Maxir, Gilead tɔ́ viŋutsuwo. 24Le Xezron ƒe ku megbe la, Kaleb de Efrata, Xezron tɔ́ srɔ̃ gbɔ, eye wòdzi Asur si va nye Tekoa tɔ́ la nɛ.
Yeraxmeel ƒe dzidzimeviwo
25Yeraxmeel, ame si nye Xezron ƒe ŋgɔgbevi la viŋutsuwoe nye esiawo: Ram, ŋgɔgbevi la kple eyometɔwo Buna, Oren, Ozem kple Axiya, 26Yerax srɔ̃ bubu nye Atara, eyae nye Onam nɔ. 27Ram, Yerameel ƒe ŋgɔgbevi viŋutsuwoe nye: Maaz, Yamin kple Eker. 28Onam viŋutsuwoe nye Samai kple Yada. Samai viŋutsuwoe nye Nadab kple Abisur.
29Abisur srɔ̃ ŋkɔe nye Abixail, eye eyae dzi Axban kple Molid nɛ. 30Nadab viŋutsuwoe nye Seled kple Apayim, ke Seled medzi vi hafi ku o. 31Apayim viŋutsue nye Yisi; Yisi viŋutsue nye Sesan, eye Sesan viŋutsue nye Axelai. 32Yada Semai nɔvi viŋutsuwoe nye: Yeter kple Yonatan. Yeter medzi vi hafi ku o. 33Yonatan viŋutsuwoe nye Pelet kple Zaza. Ame siawoe nye Yeraxmeel ƒe dzidzimeviwo. 34Sesan medzi ŋutsuvi o, nyɔnuviwo ko wòdzi. Ke kluvi aɖe si ŋkɔ nye Yarxa la nɔ esi. Etso Egipte. 35Ale Sesan tsɔ via nyɔnu na eƒe kluvi Yarxa wòɖe eye wòdzi Atai nɛ. 36Atai nye Natan tɔ́a, eye Natan nye Zabad tɔ́a. 37Zabad nye Eflal tɔ́a, eye Eflal nye Obed tɔ́a. 38Obed nye Yehu tɔ́a eye Yehu nye Azarya tɔ́a. 39Azarya nye Xelez tɔ́a, eye Xelez nye Eleasa tɔ́a. 40Eleasa nye Sisemai tɔ́a, eye Sisemai nye Salum tɔ́a. 41Salum nye Yekamya tɔ́a, eye Yekamya nye Elisama tɔ́a.
Kaleb ƒe dzidzimevi bubuwo
42Kaleb nye Yeraxmeel nɔviŋutsu. Kaleb viŋutsuwoe nye: Mesa, eƒe ŋgɔgbevi, ame si nye Sif tɔ́a, eyometɔe nye Maresa, eyae nye Xebron tɔ́a. 43Xebron viŋutsuwoe nye: Korax, Tapuax, Rekem kple Sema. 44Sema nye Raxam tɔ́a, eye Raxam nye Yorkeam tɔ́a. Rekem nye Samai tɔ́a. 45Samai viŋutsue nye Maon, eye Maon nye Bet-Zur tɔ́a. 46Efa, Kaleb ƒe ahiãvi dzi Xaran, Moza kple Gazez; ke Xaran hã dzi vi hetsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Gazez. 47Yadai viwoe nye: Regem, Yotam, Gesan, Pelet, Efa kple Saaf. 48Maaxa, Kaleb ƒe ahiãvi bubu, dzi Seber kple Tirxana. 49Eya kee dzi Saaf, ame si nye Madmana kple Seva tɔ́a; Seva va nye Maxbena kple Gibea tɔ́a. Kaleb vinyɔnu ŋkɔe nye Axsa. 50Kaleb ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye esiawo:
Xur, Efrata ƒe ŋgɔgbevi viŋutsue nye Sobal, ame si tsò Kiryat-Yearim-du la tɔ́a. 51Salma tsò Betlehem, eye Xaref tsò Bet-Gader. 52Sobal, ame si tsò Kiryat-Yearim la ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Haroetɔwo kple Menuxotitɔwo ƒe afã. 53Kiryat-Yearim ƒomeawo nye Yitritɔwo, Putitɔwo. Sumatitɔwo kple Misraitɔwo. Ƒome siawo mee Zoreatitɔwo kple Estaolitɔwo dzɔ tso. 54Salma ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Betlehemtɔwo, Netofatitɔwo, Atarot, Bet-Yoab kple Manafitɔwo ƒe afã siwo nye Zoreatitɔwo. 55Agbalẽfialawo ƒe ƒome siawo nɔ Yabez: Tifatitɔwo, Simatitɔwo kple Suxatitɔwo katã wonye Kenitɔwo tso Xamat, Rexab ƒe ƒome la me.

Title: KRONIKA I 3
Content:
Fia David viwo
1David vi siwo wodzi nɛ le Xebron lawoe nye esiawo: Amnon, eƒe ŋgɔgbevi, si nye Axinoam, Yesreel-nyɔnu la dzi nɛ. Eveliae nye Daniɛl si Abigail, Karmel-nyɔnu la, dzi nɛ. 2Etɔ̃liae nye Absalom si nye Gesur-fia, Talmai vinyɔnu Maaxa vi. Eneliae nye Adoniya, Xagit vi. 3Atɔ̃liae nye Abital vi Sefatya. Adeliae nye Yitream, si nye srɔ̃a Egla vi. 4 Vi adee wodzi na David le Xebron, afi si wòɖu fia le ƒe adrẽ kple afã. Eɖu fia ƒe bla etɔ̃ vɔ etɔ̃ le Yerusalem. 5Vi siwo wodzi nɛ le Yerusalem la woe nye: Simea, Sobab, Natan kple Salomo. Wonye vi ene siwo Bat-Sua, Amiel vinyɔnu la dzi nɛ. 6Bubuwoe nye: Yibxar, Elisama, Elifelet, 7Noga, Nefeg, Yafia, 8Elisama, Elyada kple Elifelet; wole ame asieke. 9Ame siawo katã nye David viŋutsuwo. Eƒe ahiãviwo ƒe viŋutsuwo mele eme o. Wo nɔvinyɔnue nye Tamar.
Fia Salomo ƒe dzidzimeviwo
10Salomo ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Rexabeam, eya vie nye Abiya, eya vie nye Asa, eye Asa vie nye Yosafat. 11Yosafat vie nye Yoram, eya vie nye Axazya, eye eya hã vie nye Yoas. 12Yoas vie nye Amazya, eya vie nye Azarya; eya vie nye Yotam. 13Yotam vie nye Axaz, eya vie nye Xizkiya, eye eya hã vie nye Manase. 14Manase vie nye Amon, eye eya vie nye Yosiya. 15Yosiya viwoe nye: Yehohanan ŋgɔgbevi la, evelia nye Yehoyakim. Etɔ̃liae nye Zedekiya, eye eneliae nye Salum. 16Yehoyakim ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Yexonya, eya vie nye Zedekiya. 17Yexonya, aboyome la viwoe nye: Sealtiel, 18Malxiram, Pedaya, Senazar, Yekamya, Hosama kple Nedabya. 19Pedaya viwoe nye: Zerubabel kple Simei. Zerubabel viwo nye: Mesulam kple Xananya. Wo nɔvinyɔnue nye Selomi. 20Via ŋutsu atɔ̃ bubuwoe nye: Xasuba, Ohel, Berexya, Xasadya kple Yusab-Xesed. 21Xananya viwoe nye: Pelatya kple Yesaya. Yesaya ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Refaya, ame si dzi Arnan, Obadya kple Sexanya. 22Sexanya vie nye Semaya, eye eya viwo nye: Xatus, Yigeal, Bariax, Nearya kple Safat. 23Nearya viwoe nye, Elyoenai, Xizkiya kple Azrikam. Wole ame etɔ̃. 24Elyoenai viwoe nye: Hodavia, Elyasib, Pelaya, Akub, Yaxanan, Delaya kple Anani. Wole ame adrẽ.

Title: KRONIKA I 4
Content:
Yuda ƒe dzidzimeviwo
1Yuda viŋutsuwoe nye: Perez, Xezron, Kelubai, Xur kple Sobal. 2Reaya, Sobal vi nye Yaxat tɔ́a, eye Yaxat nye Axumai kple Lahad tɔ́. Woawoe nye Zoreatitɔwo ƒe ƒometɔwo. 3Etam viŋutsuwoe nye: Yezreel, Yisma kple Yidbas. Wo nɔvinyɔnu ŋkɔe nye Hazieponi. 4Penuel nye Gedor tɔ́a, eye Ezer nye Xusa tɔ́a. Ame siawo nye Xur, Efrata ƒe ŋgɔgbevi si tsò Betlehem la ƒe dzidzimeviwo. 5Asxur, Tekoa tɔ́ ɖe srɔ̃ eve: Xelea kple Naara. 6Naara dzi Axuzam, Xefer, Temeni kple Axastari nɛ. Woawoe nye Naara ƒe viŋutsuwo. 7Xelea viŋutsuwoe nye: Zeret, Yizhar kple Etnan. 8Koz nye Anub, Hazobeba kple Harum vi, Axarxel ƒe ƒomeawo. 9Bùbu nɔ Yabez ŋu wu nɔviawo. Nɔa tsɔ ŋkɔ Yabez nɛ gblɔ be: “Elabe mese veve le edzidzi me.” 10Yabez do gbe ɖa na Israel ƒe Mawu la be: “O yram, eye nàkeke nye anyigba ɖe enu. Nɔ kplim, eye nàkpɔ tanye tso nuveviwɔame me ale be magawɔm o!” Ale Mawu na nu si wòbia lae.
Ƒomexexlẽfia bubuwo
11Kelub, Suxa nɔvi nye Mexir tɔ́a, ame si nye Eston tɔ́a. 12Eston nye Bet-Rafa, Paseax kple Texina, ame si nye Naxas tɔ́a. Ame siawo nye Rexa-ŋutsuwo. 13Kenaz viwoe nye Otniel kple Seraya. Otniel viŋutsuwoe nye Xatat kple Meonotai. 14Meonotai nye Ofra tɔ́a eye Seraya nye Yoab tɔ́a, ame si ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye atikpalawo. Wonɔ Aɖaŋudɔwɔlawo ƒe Bali la me. 15Kaleb, Yefune vi, viwoe nye: Iru, Ela kple Naam. Ela vie nye Kenaz. 16Yehalelel viwoe nye: Sif, Zifa, Tirya kple Asareel. 17Ezra viwoe nye: Yeter, Mered, Efer kple Yalon. Mered ɖe Egipte Fiagã vinyɔnu Bitya, ame si dzi Miryam, Samai kple Yisbax, ame si tsò Estemoa-du la. 18Mered srɔ̃ Yuda-nyɔnu la dzi Yered, ame si tsò Gedor-dua kple Xeber, ame si tsò Soko-du kpakple Yekutuel ame si tsò Zanoax-du. 19Hodiya srɔ̃ Naham nɔvinyɔnu ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Garmitɔ si tsò Kegila kple Maxat ƒe dzidzimevi siwo nɔ Estemoa. 20Simon viwoe nye: Amnon, Rina, Ben-Xanan kple Tilon. Yisi viwoe nye: Zoxet kple Ben-Zoxet.
Sela ƒe dzidzimeviwo
21Sela, Yuda vi, viŋutsuwoe nye: Ger, ame si tsò Lexa-dua, Laada, ame si tsò Maresa-dua kple ƒome siwo nye avɔ ɣi biɖibiɖi lɔ̃lawo eye wonɔ Asbea. 22Egadzi Yokim kple Kozebanɔlawo kple Yoas kpakple Saraf, ame siwo ɖu amegã le Moab kple Yasubi-Lexem. Blemanyawoe nye esiawo. 23Wonye zemelawo nɔ fia ƒe dɔ me, eye wonɔ Netaim kple Gedera.
Simeon ƒe dzidzimeviwo
24Simeon viŋutsuwoe nye: Nemuel, Yamin, Yarib, Serax kple Saul. 25Saul dzi Salum, eya vie nye Mibsam. Mibsam vie nye Misma. 26Misma viŋutsuwoe nye Xamuel; eya vie nye Zakur eya vie nye Simei. 27Viŋutsu wui ade kple vinyɔnu ade nɔ Simei si, ke vi geɖe menɔ nɔviawo ya si o, eya ta woƒe ƒome la medzi sɔ gbɔ abe Yuda viŋutsuwo tɔ ene o.
28 Wonɔ Beer-Seba, Molada, Xazar-Sual, 29Bilha, Ezem, Tolad, 30Betuel, Xorma, Ziklag, 31Bet-Markabot, Xazar-Susim, Bet-Birei kple Saarayim-duawo me. Woƒe duwoe nye esiawo va se ɖe David ƒe fiaɖuɣi. 32Woƒe kɔƒe siwo kpe ɖe du siawo ŋu la woe nye: Etam, Ayin, Rimon, Toxen kple Asan. Wole kɔƒe atɔ̃. 33Kɔƒe bubuwo gaƒo xlã du siawo yi ɖase Baal. Esiawoe nye woƒe nɔƒewo, eye ƒomexexlẽfia tɔxɛ le wo si.
34Mesobab, Yamlex, Yosa, Amazya vi; 35Yoel, Yehu, si nye Yosibya vi, si nye Seraya vi, si nye Asiel vi; 36Elyoenai, Yaakoba, Yesoxaya, Asaya, Adiel, Yesimiel, Benaya kple 37Ziza, Sifei vi, ame si nye Alon vi, eya si nye Yadaya vi, ame si nye Simri vi, ame si nye Semaya vi. 38Ame siwo ŋkɔwo woxlẽ la nye amegãwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me, eye woƒe aƒekɔwo keke ta ŋutɔ. 39Wokaka ɖo ta Gedor, le bali si le afi ma la ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome, be yewoaɖadi lãnyiƒe na yewoƒe lãhawo. 40Wokpɔ lãnyiƒe dama nyuiwo le afi ma. Anyigba la keke le goawo katã me, eye wokpɔ ŋutifafa kple dzidzeme le afi ma. 41Le Yuda-fia Xizkiya ƒe fiaɖuɣi la, ame siwo ŋkɔ woyɔ va yi la yi ɖadze afi ma nɔlawo dzi. Wogbã woƒe agbadɔwo kple woƒe aƒe siwo le afi ma la, eye wotsrɔ̃ wo keŋkeŋ. Woxɔ woƒe nɔƒe wòzu wo tɔ va se ɖe egbe elabe lãnyiƒe nyuiwo le afi ma na woƒe lãhawo. 42Simeon viwo dome ame alafa atɔ̃ yi Seir-toa gbɔ. Woƒe kplɔlawoe nye Pelatya, Nearya, Refaya kple Uziel. Wonye Yisi viwo. 43Woɖawu Amalekitɔ siwo susɔ ɖe afi ma la, henɔ wo teƒe va se ɖe egbe.

Title: KRONIKA I 5
Content:
Ruben ƒe dzidzimeviwo
1 Ruben, Israel ƒe ŋgɔgbevi ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe ŋutinya: Ruben ye nye Israel ƒe ŋgɔgbevi, ke esi wòdɔ kple tɔ́a ƒe ahiãvi ta la, woxɔ ŋgɔgbevinyenye la le esi tsɔ na Israel vi, Yosef viwo. Eya ta womexlẽ eƒe dzidzime fia ɖe eƒe ŋgɔgbevinyenye nu o. 2 Togbɔ be Yuda-to la va kpɔ ŋusẽ wu le to bubuawo dome, eye dziɖula dzɔ tso eme hã la, ŋgɔgbevinyenye la nye Yosef tɔ. 3Ruben, Israel ƒe ŋgɔgbeviwoe nye: Henox, Palu, Xezron kple Karmi. 4Yoel vie nye Semaya, eya vie nye Gog, eya vie nye Simei. 5Eya vie nye Mixa, eya vie nye Reaya, eye eya vie nye Baal. 6Baal vie nye Beera, ame si Asiria-fia Tiglat-Pileser ɖe aboyoe; Beerae nye Ruben-to la ƒe tatɔ. 7Le ƒomea ƒe dzidzimegbalẽ me la, wode dzesi nɔviawo ɖe woƒe dzidzime nu ale: Yeiel ye nye ƒomea ƒe tatɔ. Eyometɔwo nye Zaxarya, 8Bela, Azaz vi, si nye Sema vi, ame si nye Yoel vi. Ƒome sia nɔ Aroer si keke ta tso Nebo yi ɖase Baal-Meon. 9Wonɔ ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo, ɖo ta kegbegbe si le Frat-tɔsisi la ƒe go sia dzi elabe woƒe lãhawo dzi ɖe edzi le Gilead-nyigba dzi. 10Le Saul ŋɔli la, Ruben-to la wɔ aʋa kple Hagritɔwo heɖu wo dzi. Ale woxɔ woƒe anyigba si le Gilead ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome la katã wòzu wo tɔ.
Gad ƒe dzidzimeviwo
11Gad ƒe dzidzimeviwo nɔ Ruben ƒe dzidzimeviwo xa le Basan-nyigba si keke de Salxa la dzi. 12Yoel ye nye ƒome lolotɔ ƒe tatɔ. Safam kplɔe ɖo. Yanai kple Safat nɔ Basan. 13Wo nɔvi siwo ma ɖe ƒome vovovowo me lae nye Mixael, Mesulam, Seba, Yorai, Yakan, Zia kple Eber; wole adrẽ. 14Ame siawo nye Abixail ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Abixail nye Xuri vi. Eya nye Yaroax vi, Yaroax nye Gilead vi, Gilead nye Mixael vi, Mixael nye Yesisai vi, Yesisai nye Yaxdo vi, Yaxdo nye Buz vi. 15Axi, Abdiel vi, si nye Guni ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi lae nye woƒe ƒomea ƒe tatɔ. 16Wonɔ Gilead, Basan-duwo me kpakple Saron ƒe nutowo katã me. 17Woŋlɔ ame siawo katã ƒe ŋkɔ ɖi le Yotam, Yuda-fia kple Yerobeam, Israel-fia ŋɔli.
Ɣedzeƒe toawo ƒe aʋakɔwo.
18Aʋakalẽawo nɔ Ruben viwo, Gad viwo kple Manase-to la ƒe afã me. Wode asrafo akpe bla ene vɔ ene alafa adrẽ bla ade. Wonya aʋaɖaŋu, eye wotsɔa akpoxɔnu kple yi, eye wonye da kple aŋutrɔdala gãwo. 19Woho aʋa ɖe Yetur, Natis kple Nodab siwo nye Hagritɔwo la ŋu. 20Woɖo dzi ɖe Mawu ŋu, eye wodo gbe ɖa yɔe le aʋa la me. Mawu se woƒe ameyɔgbe la, eye wòkpe ɖe wo ŋu ale be woɖu Hagritɔwo kple dukɔ siwo kpe ɖe wo ŋu la dzi. 21Nu siwo woha le aʋa la me la woe nye: kposɔ akpe bla atɔ̃, alẽ akpe alafa eve bla atɔ̃ kple tedzi akpe eve. Woɖe aboyo ame akpe alafa ɖeka hã. 22Wowu woƒe futɔ geɖewo, elabe Mawu wɔ aʋa la na wo. Wonɔ ameawo ƒe anyigba dzi va se ɖe esime woyi aboyo me.
Manase-to afã si le ɣedzeƒe gome
23Manase ƒe to afã si le ɣedzeƒe gome la dzi sɔ gbɔ ŋutɔ. Wokeke ta tso Basan yi Baal-Xermon kple Seir kple Xermon-to ŋu. 24Woƒe ƒometatɔwoe nye Efer, Yisi, Eliel, Azriel, Yirmeya, Hodavia kple Yaxdiel. Wonye ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo kple kplɔla xɔŋkɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me.
Wokplɔ ɣedzeƒe gome toawo yi aboyo me
25Ruben-to, Gad-to kple Manase ƒe to afã la meɖi anukware na wo tɔ́wo ƒe Mawu la o. Wowɔ ahasi kple dukɔ siwo Mawu nyà ɖa le wo ŋgɔ la ƒe mawuwo. 26 Ale Israel ƒe Mawu la na Asiria-fia Pul, si wogayɔna hã be Tiglat-Pileser la, tso ɖe Ruben, Gad kple Manase ƒe to afã la ŋu eye wòkplɔ wo dzo yi Xalax, Xaber kple Hara kpakple Gozan-tɔsisi la nu. Wogale afi ma va se ɖe egbe o.

Title: KRONIKA I 6
Content:
Levi ƒe dzidzimeviwo: Nunɔlagãwo
1Levi viwoe nye Gerson, Kehat kple Merari. 2Kehat viwoe nye: Amram, Yizhar, Xebron kple Uziel. 3Amram viwoe nye Aron kple Mose; wo nɔvinyɔnue nye Miryam. Aron viwoe nye: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar kple Itamar. 4Eleazar ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye esi: Pinehas dzi Abisua, 5eya dzi Buki, eya dzi Uzi. 6Uzi dzi Zeraxya, eya dzi Merayot, eya dzi Amarya, eya dzi Axitub. 7Kehat viwo nye: Aminadab, eya ƒe vi nye Konax, eya ƒe vi nye Asir, 8eya dzi Zadok, eya dzi Aximaaz, 9eya dzi Azarya, eye eya dzi Yehohanan. 10Yehohanan dzi Azarya, ame si wɔ nunɔladɔ le gbedoxɔ si fia Salomo tu ɖe Yerusalem la me. 11Azarya dzi Amarya, eye eya dzi Axitub. 12Eya dzi Zadok, ame si dzi Salum, 13eya dzi Xilkiya eye eya dzi Azarya. 14Azarya dzi Seraya eye eya dzi Yozadak. 15Ke Yozadak yi aboyo me esi Aƒetɔ to Nebukadnezar dzi ɖe aboyo Yuda kple Yerusalem.
Levi vi bubuawo
16 Levi viwoe nye Gerson, Kehat kple Merari. 17Gerson viwo ƒe ŋkɔwoe nye Libni kple Simei. 18Kehat viwoe nye Amram, Yizhar, Xebron kple Uziel. 19Merari viwoe nye Maxeli kple Musi. Ame siawoe nye Levi-ƒomea ƒe tɔgbuiwo. 20Gerson ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye Libni, eya vie nye Yaxat, eya vie nye Zima, 21eya vie nye Yoax, eya vie nye Ido, eya vie nye Zerax, eya vie nye Yeatrai. 22Kehat ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Aminadab, eya vie nye Korax, eya vie nye Asir, 23eya vie nye Elkana, eya vie nye Ebyasaf, eya vie nye Asir, 24eya vie nye Taxat, eya vie nye Uriel, eya vie nye Uziya, eye eya vie nye Saul. 25Elkana viwoe nye Amasai kple Aximot. 26Aximot vie nye Elkana, eya vie nye Zofai, eya vie nye Naxat, 27eya vie nye Eliab, eya vie nye Yexoram, eye eya vie nye Elkana. 28Samuel viwoe nye: Yoel, ŋgɔgbevia kple eyometɔ Abiya. 29Merari ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Maxeli, eya vie nye Libni, eya vie nye Simei, eya vie nye Uza, 30eya vie nye Simea, eya vie nye Xagiya, eye eya vie nye Asaya. 31Ame siwo David ɖo be woakpɔ hadzidzi dzi le Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔ la me esime nubablaɖaka la va ɖo afi ma la woawoe nye esiawo. 32Wodzia ha subɔa Mawu le agbadɔ la nu, va se ɖe esime Salomo tu Aƒetɔ ƒe xɔ la le Yerusalem, eye wosubɔna le ɖoɖo nu. 33Ame siwo wɔ dɔ sia kple woƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Kehat-ƒomea: Heman, hɛnɔ si nye Yoel vi. Eƒe dzidzime ɖatu Israel ale: Samuel vi si nye 34Elkana, Yeroxam, Eliel. Toax, 35Zuf, Elkana, Maxat, Amasai, 36Elkana, Yoel, Azarya, Zefanya. 37Taxat, Asir, Ebyasaf, Korax. 38Yizhar, Kehat, Levi, Israel. 39Nɔvia Asaf si nɔa eƒe ɖusime la ƒe dzidzime ɖatu Levi ale: Asaf, Berexya, Simea, 40Mixael, Baaseya, Malkiya, 41Etni, Zerax, Adaya, 42Etan, Zima, Simei, 43ame si nye Yaxat vi, ame si nye Gerson vi, ame si nye Levi vi. 44Wo nɔvi, Merari viwo nɔ miame: Etan nye Kisi vi, ame si nye Abdi vi, ame si nye Malux vi, 45ame si nye Xasabya vi, ame si nye Amazya vi, ame si nye Xilkiya vi, 46ame si nye Amzi vi, ame si nye Bani vi, ame si nye Semer vi, 47ame si nye Maxeli vi, ame si nye Musi vi, ame si nye Merari vi, ame si nye Levi vi. 48Woɖo wo nɔvi Levi viwo, ne woawɔ dɔ sia dɔ le Mawu ƒe aƒe la me.
Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo
49Ke Aron kple via ŋutsuwo doa dzo ɖe numemevɔsamlekpui la kple lifivɔsamlekpui siwo woɖo hena kɔkɔeƒe la ƒe dɔwo katã la dzi be woalé avu na Israel le se siwo katã Mose, Mawu ƒe dɔla la de la nu.
50Aron viŋutsuwoe nye: Eleazar, eya vie nye Pinehas, eya vie nye Abisua, 51eya vie nye Buki, eya vie nye Uzi, eya vie nye Zeraxya, 52eya vie nye Merayot, eya vie nye Amarya, eya vie nye Axitub, 53eya vie nye Zadok, eye eya vie nye Aximaaz.
Levi viwo ƒe nɔƒewo
54Woƒe nɔƒewo le woƒe anyigba me le woƒe aƒetsotso nuwoe nye esiawo: Aron vi siwo tso Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome la me tɔe nye esi: Woawo dzie nudzidze la dze gbã. 55Wotsɔ Xebron na wo ɖe Yuda-nyigba dzi kple lãnyiƒe si le eŋu godoo; 56ke wotsɔ du la ƒe agble kple eƒe kɔƒewo na Kaleb, Yefune vi la. 57Wotsɔ sitsoƒeduwo na Aron viwo siwo nye: Xebron, Libna kple eŋu lãnyiƒe; Yatir kple Estemoa kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo; 58Xilen kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Debir kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo; 59Asan kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Bet-Semes kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 60Benyamin-to la me tɔwoe nye: Geba kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Alemet kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Anatot kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. Du siwo katã le woƒe ƒomea me la le du wui ene. 61Wodzidze nu tsɔ du ewo na Kehat viwo, siwo nye to la ƒe ƒome susɔeawo la, tso toa ƒe afã, Manase ƒe to afã me. 62Wona du wui atɔ̃ Gerson viwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu ɖe Isaxar-to, Aser-to, Naftali-to kple Manase-to afã me le Basan. 63Wodzidze nu, tsɔ du wui eve na Merari viwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu ɖe Ruben-to, Gad-to kple Zebulon-to la me. 64Ale Israel viwo tsɔ duawo kple wo ŋu lãnyiƒewo na Levi viwo. 65Wogadzidze nu tsɔ du siwo ŋkɔwo woyɔ la na wo ɖe Yuda-to, Simeon-to kple Benyamin-to me. 66Wotsɔ duwo na Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome aɖewo ɖe Efrayim-to la ƒe nutome. 67Wotsɔ sitsoƒeduwo na wo: Sixem kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo le Efrayim-tonyigba dzi, Gezer kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, 68Yokmeam kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Bet-Xoron kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo; 69Ayalon kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Gat-Rimon kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 70Wotsɔ Aner kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Bileam kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo na Kehat viwo ƒe ƒome susɔeawo ɖe Manase-to afã la me.
71Wotsɔ teƒe tso Manase-to afã me na Gerson viwo: Golan le Basan kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Astarot kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 72Tso Isaxar-to la me wotsɔ: Kedes kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo; Dobrat kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, 73Ramot kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Anem kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 74Esiwo tso Aser-to la me la woe nye: Masal kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Abdon kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, 75Xukok kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Rexob kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 76Esiwo tso Naftali-to la me la woe nye: Kedes le Galilea kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Xamon kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Kiryataim kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 77Esiwo tso Zebulon-to la me wotsɔ na Merari vi susɔeawo la woe nye: Rimono kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Tabor kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 78Esiwo tso Ruben-to la me le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe gome la woe nye: Bezer le gbegbe kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Yaza kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, 79Kedemot kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Mefaat kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo. 80Esiwo tso Gad-to la me la woe nye: Ramot le Gilead kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, Maxanaim kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo, 81Xesbon kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo kpakple Yazer kple eŋu lãnyiƒewo.

Title: KRONIKA I 7
Content:
Isaxar ƒe dzidzimeviwo
1Isaxar viŋutsuwoe nye: Tola, Pua, Yasub kple Simron; wole ame ene. 2Tola viŋutsuwoe nye: Uzi, Refaya, Yeriel, Yaxmai, Yibsan kple Samuel. Ame siawoe nye Tola ƒe ƒome la ƒe tatɔwo. Wonye kalẽtɔwo le ƒomea me. Le David ŋɔli la, woƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe xexlẽme de ame akpe bla eve vɔ eve alafa ade. 3Uzi vie nye Yizraxya, eye eya viwoe nye: Mixael, Obadya, Yoel kple Yisiya; wole ame atɔ̃. Wo katã nye ƒometatɔwo. 4Hekpe ɖe ame siawo ŋu la, aʋawɔla akpe bla etɔ̃ vɔ ade nɔ ƒomeawo me ɖe woƒe dzɔdzɔme kple aʋalɔgowo nu, elabe woɖe srɔ̃ geɖe, eye viŋutsuwo le wo si fũu. 5Wo nɔvi siwo tso Isaxar-to la katã me la de aʋakalẽtɔ akpe bla enyi vɔ adrẽ ɖe woƒe ƒomexexlẽme nu.
Benyamin ƒe dzidzimeviwo
6Benyamin viŋutsuwoe nye: Bela, Bexer kple Yediael; wole ame etɔ̃. 7Bela viwoe nye: Ezbon, Uzi, Uziel, Yerimot kple Iri; ame atɔ̃ siwo nye ƒometatɔwo kple kalẽtɔ xɔŋkɔwo. Ðe dzidzimexexlẽfia nu la, woƒe dzidzimeviwo de ame akpe bla eve vɔ eve bla etɔ̃ vɔ ene. 8Bexer viŋutsuwoe nye: Zemira, Yoas, Eliezer, Elyoenai, Imri, Yeremot, Abiya, Anatot kple Alemet. Ame siawo katã nye Bexer viŋutsuwo. 9Woƒe ƒometatɔ siwo nye kalẽtɔwo la le ame akpe bla eve alafa eve le woƒe dzidzimexexlẽfia nu.
10Yadiael vie nye Bihan; Bilhan viwoe nye: Yeus, Benyamin, Ehud, Kenaana, Zetam, Tarsis kple Axisahar. 11Ame siawo katã nye Yadiael vi siwo nye ƒometatɔ kple kalẽtɔwo. Woƒe dzidzimevi siwo le klalo na aʋawɔwɔ la de ame akpe wui adrẽ alafa eve. 12Supim kple Xupim nye Ir viwo, eye Xusim nye Axer vi.
Naftali ƒe dzidzimeviwo
13Naftali ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye: Yaxziel, Guni, Yezer kple Salum; wonye Bilha ƒe dzidzimeviwo.
Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo
14Manase viwoe nye Asriel kple Maxir. Eƒe ahiãvi si nye Aram-nyɔnu lae dzi wo. Maxir ye nye Gilead tɔ́. 15Maxir ɖe srɔ̃ eve; ɖeka ŋkɔe nye Maaxa, si nye Xupim kple Supim nɔvinyɔnu; evelia ŋkɔe nye Zelofxad. Eya dzi nyɔnuviwo sɔŋ. 16Maxir srɔ̃ Maaxa dzi viŋutsuvi eve, eye wòna ŋkɔ wo be Peres kple Seres. Peres viŋutsuwoe nye Ulam kple Rekem. 17Ulam vie nye Bedan. Ame siawo katã nye Gilead vi, Maxir vi ame si nye Manase tɔgbuiyɔvi la, ƒe dzidzimeviwo. 18Gilead nɔvinyɔnu Hamolexet dzi Ishod, Abiezer kple Maxla. 19Semida viwoe nye Axyan, Sixem, Likxi kple Aniam.
Efrayim ƒe dzidzimeviwo
20Efrayim vie nye Sutelax; Sutelax vie nye Bered, eye eya vie nye Taxat. Taxat vie nye Eleada, eye eya vie nye Taxat; 21Taxat vie nye Zabad, eye eya vie nye Sutelax kple Ezer kpakple Elead. Ke Gatitɔ siwo nye anyigba dzi tɔwo la wu wo esime wova be woalé woƒe lãwo. 22Wo tɔ́ Efrayim fa na wo ŋkeke geɖe eye nɔviawo va fa akɔ nɛ. 23Esi wògadɔ kple srɔ̃a la, efɔ fu eye wodzi ŋutsuvi. Etsɔ ŋkɔ nɛ be Beria, elabe dzɔgbevɔ̃e dzɔ ɖe eƒe aƒe dzi.
24Efrayim vinyɔnue nye Seera. Eyae tso Bet-Xoron Anyigbe kple Bet-Xeron Dzigbe kpakple Uzen-Seera. 25Efrayim viŋutsue nye Refax. Eya vie nye Resef, eya vie nye Telax; eya vie nye Taxan. 26Taxan vie nye Ladan; eya vie nye Amihud; eya vie nye Elisama, 27si vie nye Nun, eye Nun vie nye Yosua. 28Woƒe anyigba kple nɔƒewoe nye Betel kple du siwo ƒo xlãe tso Naaran le ɣedzeƒe lɔƒo va se ɖe Gezer kple eŋu du siwo le ɣetoɖoƒe lɔƒo kple tso Sixem kple eŋu duwo me ɖaɖo Aya kple eŋu duwo me. 29Manase ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe anyigbawoe nye: Bet-Sean, Taanax, Megido kple Dor kpakple wo ŋu duwo. Teƒe siawo katã nye Yosef, Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe nɔƒe.
Aser ƒe dzidzimeviwo
30Aser viwoe nye: Yimna, Yisva, Yisvi, Beria kple wo nɔvinyɔnu Serax. 31Beria viwoe nye Xeber kple Malkiel, ame si nye Birzayit tɔ́. 32Xeber dzi Yaflet, Somer, Xotam kple wo nɔvinyɔnu Sua. 33Yaflet viŋutsuwoe nye: Pasax, Bimhal kple Asvat. Ame siawo nye Yaflet viwo. 34Somer viwo nye: Axi, Roga, Xuba kple Aram. 35Nɔvia Helem viwoe nye: Zofax, Yimna, Seles kple Amal. 36Zofax ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Suax, Xarnefer, Sual, Beri, Yimra, 37Bezer, Hod, Sama, Silsa, Yitran kple Beera. 38Yeter ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Yefune, Pispa kple Ara. 39Ula ƒe dzidzimeviwo nye Arax, Xaniel kple Rizya. 40Ame siawo katã nye Aser ƒe dzidzimeviwo. Wonye ƒometatɔwo, aʋawɔla kalẽtɔwo kple kpɔla xɔŋkɔwo. Aser ƒe dzidzimevi siwo ate ŋu ayi aʋa la de ame akpe bla eve vɔ ade.

Title: KRONIKA I 8
Content:
Benyamin ƒe dzidzimeviwo
1Benyamin dzi Bela, eƒe ŋgɔgbevi. Asbel ye nye evelia, etɔ̃liae nye: Axrax, 2eneliae nye Noxa eye atɔ̃lia nye Rafa. 3Bela ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: Adar, Gera, Abihud, 4Abisua, Naeman, Axoax, 5Gera, Sefufan kple Xuram. 6Ehud ƒe dzidzimeviwoe nye: 7Naeman, Axiya kple Gera. Wonye woƒe ƒometatɔwo le Geber. Ke woɖe aboyo wo yi Manaxat. Gera, ame si dzi Uza kple Axihud lae kplɔ wo yi aboyo mee. 8Esi Saxarayim gbe srɔ̃awo, Xusim kple Baara, megbe la, edzi viwo 9le Moab-nyigba dzi. Srɔ̃a Xodes dzi Yobab, Zibya, Mesa, Malkam, 10Yenz, Sobya kple Mirma nɛ. Wonye via siwo nye ƒometatɔwo. 11Xusim dzi Abitub kple Elpaal nɛ. 12Elpaal viwoe nye: Eber, Misam kple Semer, ame si tsò Ono kple Lod kpakple wo ŋu duwo.
Benyamintɔ siwo nɔ Gat kple Ayalon
13Beria kple Sema nye Ayalontɔwo ƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo eye wonyà Gatitɔwo wosí. 14Axyo, Sasak, Yermot, 15Zebadya, Arad, Eder, 16Mixael, Yispa kple Yoxa, ame siwo nye Beria viwo.
Benyamintɔ siwo nɔ Yerusalem
17Zebadya, Mesulam, Xiski, Xeber, 18Yismerai, Yizia kple Yobab; ame siawo nye Elpaal viwo. 19Yakin, Zixri, Zabdi, 20Elienai, Ziletai, Eliel, 21Adaya, Beraya kple Simrat; woawo nye Simei viwo. 22Yispan, Eber, Eliel, 23Abdon, Zixri, Xanan, 24Xananya, Elam, Antotiya, 25Yifdeya kple Penuel; woawo nye Sasak viwo. 26Samserai, Sexarya, Atalya, 27Yaaresya, Eliya kple Zixri; woawo nye Yeroxam viwo. 28Ame siawo nye woƒe aƒekɔwo ƒe tatɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu, eye wonɔ Yerusalem.
Benyamintɔ siwo nɔ Gibeon kple Yerusalem
29Ame si tsò Gibeon la nɔ Gibeon. Srɔ̃a ŋkɔ nye Maaxa. 30Eƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye Abdon eye eyometɔwoe nye: Zur, Kis, Baal, Nadab, 31Gedor, Axyo kple Zexer. 32Miklot dzi Simea. Ame siawo hã nɔ wo nɔviwo gbɔ le Yerusalem.
Fia Saul ƒe dzidzimeviwo
33Ner dzi Kis, eye Kis dzi Saul, eye Saul dzi Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab kple Esbaal. 34Yonatan vie nye Merib-Baal, eye Merib-Baal dzi Mixa. 35Mixa viŋutsuwoe nye: Piton, Melex, Taxrea kple Axaz. 36Axaz dzi Yoada eye Yoada dzi Alemet, Azmavet kple Zimri. Zimri dzi Moza. 37Moza dzi Binea, eye eya viŋutsue nye Rafa. Rafa vie nye Eleasa, ame si dzi Azel. 38Viŋutsu ade nɔ Azel si; woawoe nye: Azrikam, Boxru, Ismael, Searya, Obadya kple Xanan. Ame siawo katã nye Azel viwo. 39Azel nɔvi Esek ƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye: Ulam, eveliae nye Yeus, eye etɔ̃liae nye Elifelet. 40Ulam viwo nye asrafo kalẽtɔwo kple aŋutrɔdalawo. Viawo kple tɔgbuiyɔviawo sɔ gbɔ de ame alafa ɖeka bla atɔ̃. Ame siawo katã wonye Benyamin-to la me tɔwo.

Title: KRONIKA I 9
Content:
Ƒome siwo va nɔ Yerusalem
1Aleae Israel-dukɔ la na woxlẽ dukɔa me viwo katã ɖe woƒe dzidzimeviwo nui, eye kpɔ ɖa, woŋlɔ esiawo ɖe Israel-fiawo ƒe Agbalẽ la me. Ke woɖe aboyo Yuda yi Babilonia le woƒe nuteƒemawɔmawɔ ta. 2 Ame gbãtɔ siwo va nɔ wo nɔƒe le woƒe duawo me la woe nye Israel nunɔlawo, Levi viwo kple gbedoxɔa me dɔwɔlawo. 3Amewo tso Yuda-to, Benyamin-to, Efrayim-to kple Manase-to la me ɖanɔ Yerusalem. 4Utai, Amihud vi, le wo dome. Amihud nye Omri vi, eyae nye Imri vi, eyae nye Bani vi, si nye Perez viwo dometɔ ɖeka, eye Perez nye Yuda vi. 5Ame siwo tso Silonitɔwo domee nye Asaya, si nye ŋgɔgbevi la ƒe dzidzimeviwo. 6Ame siwo tso Serox ƒe dzidzimeviwo me la woe nye Yeuel kple nɔviawo. Ame siawo le ame alafa ade bla asieke. 7Ame siwo tso Benyamin-toa me la dometɔ ɖekae nye Salu. Salu nye Mesulam vi; tɔgbuiae nye Hodavia, eye tɔgbuitɔgbuiae nye Hasenua. 8Bubue nye Yibneya, Yeroxam vi. Bubu hãe nye Ela, Uzi vi, si tɔgbuie nye Mexri. Bubu hãe ganye Mesulam, Sefatya vi, Reguel tɔgbuiyɔvi kple Yibner ƒe tɔgbuitɔgbuiyɔvi. 9Ame siawo katã nye ƒometatɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo nu. Wo kple wo nɔviwo de ame alafa asieke bla atɔ̃.
Nunɔla siwo yi ɖanɔ Yerusalem
10Ame siwo tso nunɔlawo dome la woe nye: Yedaya, Yoyarib, Yaxin, 11Azarya, si nye nunɔla gã le Mawu ƒe aƒe la nu. Enye Xilkiya vi. Xilkiya nye Mesulam vi, eye Mesulam nye Zadok vi. Zadok nye Merayot vi. Merayot nye Axitub vi. 12Adaya nye Yeroxam vi. Eyae nye Pasxur vi, eye eya nye Malkiya vi kple Masai, Adiel vi. Adiel nye Yaxzera vi, eyae nye Mesulam vi, eyae nye Mesilemit vi, eye eya nye Imer vi. 13Ame siawo ƒe ƒometɔwo kple woƒe ƒometatɔwo de ame akpe ɖeka alafa adrẽ bla ade. Wonyo nyuie asubɔ le Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe la me.
Levi vi siwo yi ɖanɔ Yerusalem
14Ame siwo tso Levi viwo dome la woe nye: Semaya, Xasub vi. Xasub nye Azrikam vi, eya nye Xasabya vi tso Merari ƒe ƒome la me. 15Bakbakar, Xeres, Galal kple Matanya, Mixa vi. Mixa nye Zixri vi, eye eya nye Asaf vi. 16Obadya, Semaya vi ame si nye Galal vi, eya nye Yedutun vi kple Berexya, Asa vi, eye Asa nye Elkana vi. Elkana nɔ Netofatitɔwo ƒe kɔƒewo me.
Gbedoxɔ me dɔwɔlawo
17 Agbonudzɔlawoe nye: Salum, Akub, Talmon, Axinam kple wo nɔviwo. Salum ye nye woƒe tatɔ. 18Wonɔ fia ƒe agbo nu le ɣedzeƒe gome tsã; woawoe dzɔ Levi viwo ƒe asaɖa la ƒe agbo nu. 19Salum, Kore vi si nye Ebyasaf ƒe tɔgbuiyɔvi kple nɔviawo tso Korax-ƒome la mee kpɔa subɔsubɔ la dzi, eye wodzɔa agbo la nu abe ale si wo tɔgbuiwo nye Aƒetɔ ƒe asaɖa la ƒe mɔnudzɔlawo tsã ene. 20Tsã la, Pinehas, Eleazar vi nye amegã ɖe wo nu, eye Aƒetɔ nɔ kplii. 21Zaxarya, Meselemya vi hã nye agbonudzɔla le godoƒegbadɔ la nu. 22Ame siwo katã wotia be woadzɔ agboa nu la de ame alafa eve wui eve. Woŋlɔ wo ŋkɔwo ɖe woƒe ƒomewo nu, le woƒe kɔƒewo me. David kple nukpɔla Samuel nye ame siwo tsɔ dɔa de wo si. 23Ale woawo kple woƒe dzidzimeviwo zu Aƒetɔ ƒe aƒe si nye agbadɔ la ƒe agbowo nudzɔlawo. Wowɔa dɔa ɖe ŋudzɔnɔɣi nu. 24Agbonudzɔlawo ma ɖe akpa eneawo dzi: ɣedzeƒe, ɣetoɖoƒe, dzigbeme kple anyigbeme. 25Wo nɔviwo tsoa woƒe kɔƒewo me vana ŋkeke adrẽ ŋkeke adrẽ be woaɖɔli wo. 26Agbonudzɔlawo ƒe amegã ene siwo nye Levi viwo ya nɔa dɔ me ɣe sia ɣi, eye woawo kpɔa Mawu ƒe xɔ la kple nudzraɖoƒewo dzi. 27Wotsia Mawu ƒe xɔ la gbɔ dɔna, elabe dzɔlawo wonye, eye woƒe dɔdeasi wònye be woaʋu xɔ la ŋdi sia ŋdi.
Levi vi bubuawo
28Wo dometɔ aɖewo ƒe dɔe nye be woakpɔ subɔsubɔ dɔwɔnuawo dzi, axlẽ wo kpɔ hafi woawɔ wo ŋudɔ, eye woagaxlẽ wo kpɔ ne wowɔ vɔ. 29Bubuwo kpɔa xɔmenuwo kple agba kɔkɔewo katã kple wɔ memee, wain, ami, dzudzɔ ʋeʋẽe donu kpakple atike ʋeʋẽewo dzi. 30Nunɔlawo vi aɖewo tsakaa atike ʋeʋẽewo wɔa ami ʋeʋẽe. 31Levitɔ Matitya, ame si nye Salum ƒe ŋgɔgbevi tso Korax-ƒome me lae kpɔa nu siwo wotɔna le agba me la dzi. 32Wo nɔvi siwo nye Kehat viwo la kpɔa vɔsabolo la dzi. Woawoe wɔnɛ na dzudzɔgbe sia dzudzɔgbe.
33Levi ƒe dzidzimevi aɖewo hã nye hadzilawo le mawuxɔ la me. Womegawɔa dɔ bubu aɖeke o, elabe wole dɔ dzi zã kple keli. 34Ame siawo katã nye ƒometatɔwo na Levi ƒe dzidzimeviwo ɖe woƒe ƒomeawo nu. Wo katã wonɔ Yerusalem.
Fia Saul ƒe ƒome
35Yeuel ame si tsò Gibeon-dua la nɔ Gibeon. Srɔ̃a ŋkɔe nye Maaxa. 36Eƒe ŋgɔgbevie nye Abdon, eye eyometɔwoe nye: Zur, Kis, Baal, Ner, Nadab, 37Gedor, Axyo, Zaxarya kple Miklot. 38Miklot dzi Simeam, eye wo kple wo nɔviwo nɔ woƒe ƒometɔwo kasa le Yerusalem. 39Ner dzi Kis, Kis dzi Saul, eye Saul dzi Yonatan, Malkisua, Abinadab kple Esbaal. 40Yonatan dzi Merib-Baal, eye Merib-Baal dzi Mixa. 41Mixa viŋutsuwoe nye: Piton, Melex, Taxrea 42kple Axaz ame si dzi Yarea, eye eya dzi Alemet, Azmavet kple Zimri. Zimri dzi Moza. 43Moza dzi Binea, Binea dzi Refaya, eye Refaya dzi Azel. 44Viŋutsu ade nɔ Azel si. Wo ŋkɔwoe nye: Azrikam, Boxru, Ismael, Searya, Obadya kple Xanan.

Title: KRONIKA I 10
Content:
Fia Saul ƒe ku
(Sam I, 31.1-13)
1Filistitɔwo wɔ aʋa kple Israelviwo, eye Israelviwo sí le wo nu. Wo dometɔ geɖewo tsi aʋa le Gilboa-toa dzi. 2Filistitɔwo nya Saul kple viawo ɖe nu, eye wowu Yonatan, Abinadab kple Malkisua siwo nye Saul viwo. 3Esi aʋa la nu sẽ ɖe edzi la, futɔwo ƒe aŋutrɔ va te Saul, eye wòxɔ abi. 4Eya ta Saul gblɔ na eƒe aʋawɔnutsɔla be: “Ðe wò yi ƒo ɖem, ne bolobolotɔ siawo nagava ɖi gbɔm o.” Ke eƒe aʋawɔnutsɔla la gbe elabe ele vɔvɔ̃m ŋutɔ. Ale Saul tsɔ eya ŋutɔ ƒe yi tu ɖi, eye wòdze enu. 5Esi aʋawɔnutsɔla la kpɔ be Saul ku la, eya hã dze eƒe yi nu heku. 6Ale Saul ŋutɔ kple via ŋutsu etɔ̃awo kpakple eƒe ƒomea katã tsrɔ̃ ɖekae. 7Esi Israelvi siwo le balia me kpɔ be aʋawɔlawo sí, eye Saul kple viawo ku la, wosí, gblẽ woƒe duwo ɖi, eye Filistitɔwo va xɔ duawo henɔ wo me.
8Le ŋkeke evea gbe, esi Filistitɔwo va be yewoaɖe nu le ame tsiaʋawo ŋu la, wokpɔ be Saul kple viawo ku ɖe Gilboa-toa dzi. 9Woɖe nu le eŋu, eye wotsɔ eƒe ta kple eƒe aʋawɔnuwo ɖo ɖe Filistitɔwo ƒe anyigba dzi godoo hetsɔ ɖe gbeƒã dzidzɔnya la na woƒe mawuwo kple dukɔ blibo la. 10Wotsɔ eƒe aʋawɔnuwo ɖada ɖe woƒe mawuƒe me, eye wotsɔ eƒe ta ku nu ɖe Dagon ƒe xɔ me.
11Yabes-Gileadtɔwo katã se nu siwo katã Filistitɔwo wɔ Saul. 12Tete woƒe kalẽtɔwo katã bla akpa, eye woyi ɖatsɔ Saul kple viawo ƒe kukuawo va Yabes. Woɖi woƒe ƒuwo ɖe ati aɖe te le Yabes, eye wotsi nu dɔ ŋkeke adrẽ.
13 Ale Saul ku elabe mewɔ nuteƒe na Aƒetɔ o, eye melé eƒe sededewo me ɖe asi o. Gawu la, ede ŋɔliyɔla gbɔ ɖabia nu, 14ke mebia nu le Aƒetɔ ya gbɔ o. Eya ta Aƒetɔ wui, eye wòna fiaɖuƒe la yi David, Yese vi la si me.

Title: KRONIKA I 11
Content:
David zu fia le Israel blibo la
(Sam II, 5.1-10)
1Israel-dukɔ blibo la va kpe ta ɖe David gbɔ le Xebron hegblɔ nɛ be: “Kpɔ ɖa, nɔvi kpamkpam míenye. 2Tso ɣe aɖe ɣi ke, esime Saul nɔ mía dzi ɖum gɔ̃ hã la, wò koe kplɔa Israel dea aʋae. Aƒetɔ, wò Mawu gblɔ na wò be: ‘Wòe le kplɔla nye ge na nye dukɔ Israel, eye wòe aɖu nye dukɔ Israel dzi.’ ” 3Ale Israel-me tsitsiwo katã va fia la gbɔ le Xebron, eye David bla nu kple wo le Xebron le Aƒetɔ ŋkume. Eyome wosi ami na David heɖoe fiae ɖe Israel-dukɔ katã nu le Aƒetɔ ƒe nya si wògblɔ to Samuel dzi la nu.
4 David kple Israel-dukɔ blibo la ho yi Yerusalem si woyɔna be Yebus. Afi mae Yebusitɔ, siwo nye anyigba la dzi tɔwo le. 5Yebusitɔwo gblɔ na David be: “Mage ɖe afi sia o.” Gake David xɔ Zion ƒe mɔ́ si nye David ƒe du la. 6David gblɔ be: “Ame si tre Yebusitɔwo sisi la lanye tatɔ kple aʋakplɔla.” Tete Yoab, Zeruya vi kpe aʋa kple wo gbã ale wòzu tatɔ. 7David nɔ mɔ́ la me, eya ta woyɔnɛ be David ƒe du. 8Eɖo gli ƒo xlã dua tso Milo la godoo va kpe, eye Yoab dzra dua ƒe akpa mamlɛa ɖo. 9David ƒe ŋusẽ le akɔ trim ɖe edzi, elabe Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokpɔla la li kplii.
David ƒe asrafo kalẽtɔwo
(Sam II, 23.8-39)
10David ƒe aʋawɔla kalẽtɔwo ƒe tatɔ siwo kpe ɖe Israel blibo la ŋu, eye wonɔ megbe nɛ sesĩe le eƒe fiaɖuɖu me la woe nye esiawo. Woawoe wɔ ɖeka tsɔ David ɖo fiae ɖe Israel nu abe ale si Aƒetɔ la gblɔe ene. 11David ƒe aʋakalẽtɔwo kple wo ŋu nyawo nye esi: Yasobeam, Xaxmoni vie nye Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo ƒe amegã. Eyae kɔ eƒe akplɔ si nu ame alafa etɔ̃ tsi le aʋakpekpe ɖeka me la ɖe dzi. 12Ame evelia le Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo dome nye Eleazar Dodo, Axoxitɔ la vi. 13Enɔ David ŋu le Pas-Damim hafi Filistitɔwo kpe aʋa kple wo le afi ma. Agble aɖe le afi ma si me ƒo le fũu. Esi dukɔ la sí le Filistitɔwo nu la, 14eya kple David yi ɖanɔ te ɖe agblea titina. Wonyà Filistitɔwo ɖa le agblea me, wu wo. To esia me Aƒetɔ na woɖu dzi keŋkeŋ. 15Asrafoawo ƒe amegã bla etɔ̃awo dometɔ etɔ̃ va David gbɔ le agakpe la gbɔ le Abulam-agado la me, esime Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Refaim-bali la me. 16David nɔ mɔ́ la me, eye Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ ƒu asaɖa anyi ɖe Betlehem. 17David gblɔ be: “Aa! Ame aɖe makpɔ tsi tso vudo si le Betlehem-gbo la nu me nam mano fifia oa?” 18Tete Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo to Filistitɔwo ƒe asaɖaa me yi ɖaku tsia tsɔ vɛ na David. Gake David melɔ̃ no tsia o. Eƒoe ɖi na Aƒetɔ boŋ, eye 19wògblɔ be: “Nye Mawu nete esia ɖa xaa tso gbɔnye. Ðe mano ŋutsu siawo ƒe ʋu si nye woƒe agbe la? Wotsɔ woƒe agbe ke ɖaku tsia vɛ. Ale wògbe enono.” Kalẽtɔ etɔ̃awoe wɔ esia.
20Abisai, Yoab nɔvi ye nye Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo ƒe tatɔ. Eyae tsɔ eƒe akplɔ wɔ aʋa kple ame alafa etɔ̃, eye wòɖu wo dzi. Esia ta wòxɔ ŋkɔ le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome. 21Eyae xɔ ŋkɔ wu le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome, eye wòzu woƒe amegã, negbe ɖeko mede Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo nu o.
22Yehoyada vi Benaya tso Kabzeel nye asrafo kalẽtɔ aɖe, si wɔ nu tsu geɖe. Eyae wu Moab-ŋutsu wɔadã eve. Eyae ɖawu dzata le vudo me esime tsikpe le dzadzam la. 23Eya kee wu Egipte-ŋutsu kako, si kɔ meta eve hã. Akplɔ si didi abe abaladoti ene la le Egiptetɔ la si. Ke eya tsɔ atizɔti ɖe asi, zɔ ɖe ŋutsua dzi, eye wòdu akplɔ la le esi, tsɔ wui. 24Nu siawoe Benaya Yehoyada vi la wɔ, eya ta eya hã xɔ ŋkɔ le Aʋawɔla Etɔ̃awo dome. 25Wode bubu eŋu le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome, negbe ɖeko mede Tatɔ Etɔ̃awo nu o. David tsɔe ɖo asrafo siwo dzɔa eŋu la nu.
26Ŋutsu kalẽtɔwo le aʋakɔawo mee nye: Asahel, Yoab nɔviŋutsu; Elxanan, Dodo vi tso Betlehem; 27Haroritɔ Samot; Pelonitɔ Xelez, 28Tekoatɔ Ira, Ikes vi; Anatotitɔ, Abiezer; 29Xusatitɔ Sibekai; Axoxitɔ Ilai; 30Netofatitɔ Maxarai; Netofatitɔ Heled, Baana vi; 31Itai, Ribai vi, tso Benyamin viwo ƒe Gibea; Piratonitɔ Benaya; 32Xurai tso Naxale-Gaas; Arabatitɔ Abiel; 33Baxarumitɔ Azmavet; Saalebonitɔ Elyaxba; 34Gizonitɔ Bene-Hasem; Hararitɔ Yonatan, Sage vi; 35Hararitɔ Axiam, Saxar vi; Elifal, Ur vi; 36Mexeratitɔ Xefer; Pelonitɔ Axiya; 37Karmeltɔ Xezro; Naarai, Ezbai vi; 38Yoel, Natan nɔviŋutsu; Mibxar, Hagri vi; 39Amontɔ Zelek; Berotitɔ Naxarai, ame si nye Zeruya vi, Yoab ƒe adekplɔvi; 40Yitritɔ Ira; Yitritɔ Gareb; 41Xititɔ Uriya; Zabad, Axelai vi; 42Adina, Siza vi, ame si nye Rubentɔ, eya nye Ruben viwo ƒe tatɔ eye ame bla etɔ̃ kpe ɖe eŋu; 43Xanan, Maaxa vi; Mitnitɔ Yosafat; 44Asteratitɔ Uziya; Sama kple Yeiel, ame siwo nye Aroertitɔ Xotam viwo; 45Yediael, Simri vi kple nɔvia ŋutsu Tizitɔ Yoxa; 46Maxavitɔ Eliel; Yeribai kple Yosaya, ame siwo nye Elnaam viwo; Moabtɔ Yitma; 47Eliel, Obed kple Yaasiel tso Mezobaya.

Title: KRONIKA I 12
Content:
Fia David ŋu nɔla gbãtɔwo tso Benyamin-to me
1Ame siwo va David gbɔ esime wòsi aʋa le Saul, Kis vi la nu ɖale Ziklag la woe nye esi. Wole aʋakalẽtɔ siwo kpe ɖe eŋu la dome. 2Wonye aŋutrɔdalawo; wotea ŋu daa aŋutrɔ eye wodaa kpe hã. Wowɔa ɖusi kple mia. Wonye Saul ƒe ƒometɔwo tso Benyamin-to la me. 3Woƒe kplɔla nye Axiezer kple Yoas, siwo nye Hasmaa viwo tso Gibea; Yeziel kple Pelet, Azmavet viwo; Beraxa kple Yehu, Anatotitɔ la 4Yismaya tso Gibeon, aʋakalẽtɔ le Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃awo dome; Yeremya, Yaxaziel, Yehohanan kple Yozabad Gederatitɔ la, 5Eluzai, Yerimot, Bealya, Semarya, Sefatya, Xarufittɔ la. 6Elkana, Yisiya, Azarel, Yoezer, Yasobeam, ame siwo nye Korax viwo; 7Yoela kple Sebadya, Yeroxam viwo tso Gedor.
David ŋu nɔlawo tso Gad-to la me
8Amewo tso Gad-to la me va David gbɔ, le mɔ́ me le gbedadaƒo la. Wonye aʋakalẽtɔ nuteƒekpɔla siwo bi le akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ ŋudɔwɔwɔ me. Woƒe mo ɖi vɔvɔ̃ abe dzata tɔ ene. Woƒe afɔ tsɔna le to dzi abe zi ene. 9Ezer nye tatɔ, evelia nye Obadya, etɔ̃lia nye Eliab, 10enelia nye Mismana, atɔ̃lia nye Yeremya, 11adelia nye Atai, adrẽlia nye Eliel, 12enyilia nye Yehohanan, asiekelia nye Elzabad, 13ewolia nye Yeremya, eye wui ɖekɛlia nye Maxbanai. 14Ame siawo nye asrafomegãwo. Wo dometɔ gblɔetɔ ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ame alafa ɖeka nu, eye sesẽtɔ ate ŋu anɔ te ɖe ame akpe ɖeka nu. 15Woawoe tsò Yordan le ɣleti gbãtɔ le ƒè la me , esime tsia ɖɔ gba go. Wode zi balia me nɔlawo katã me le ɣedzeƒe kple ɣetoɖoƒe, eye wosí.
Fia David ŋu nɔla bubuwo tso Benyamin kple Yuda toawo me
16Amewo tso Benyamin ƒe dzidzimeviwo kple Yuda ƒe dzidzimeviwo dome va David gbɔ le mɔ́ la me. 17Edo go yi ɖakpe wo, eye wògblɔ na wo be: “Nenye ŋutifafa me mieva le, be yewoakpe ɖe ŋunye la, ekema mawɔ ɖeka kpli mi tso dzime. Ke ne ɖe mieva be yewoadem asi na nye futɔwo, le esime nyemewɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke o la, mía tɔgbuiwo ƒe Mawu la nekpɔe ne wòaka mo!” 18Tete gbɔgbɔ va Amasai, Aʋawɔla Blaetɔ̃wo ƒe kpɔla dzi, eye wògblɔ be:
“David, míele dziwò.
Wò Yese vi, tɔwòe míenye.
Ŋutifafa, ŋutifafa na wò!
Ŋutifafa na ame si kpe ɖe ŋuwò
elabe wò Mawue nye wò kpeɖeŋutɔ.”
Ale David xɔ wo, eye wòwɔ wo asrafomegãwo le eƒe aʋakɔ la me.
David ŋu nɔlawo tso Manase-to la me
19Asrafo aɖewo tso Manase-to la me va David dzi, esime eya kple Filistitɔwo ho aʋa ɖe Saul ŋu. Ke womeyi aʋa la kpli wo o, elabe Filistitɔwo ƒe dumegãwo na wotrɔ dzo. Wogblɔ be: “Ne David trɔ ɖade eƒe aƒetɔ Saul dzi la, ekema míaƒe tae nye ema zu Saul tɔ.” 20Esi David yi Ziklag la, ame siwo tso Manase-to la me yi edzi la woe nye: Adnax, Yozabad, Yediael, Mixael, Yozabad, Elihu kple Ziletai. Wonye asrafo akpewo kplɔlawo tso Manase. 21Esi wònye aʋakalẽtɔwo kple aʋakplɔlawo wonye ta la, wokpe ɖe David ŋu le aʋakɔ la kpɔkplɔ me. 22Gbe sia gbe la, amewo dzona vaa David dzi be yewoakpe ɖe eŋu, ale be aʋakɔ gã ŋutɔ ɖo esi abe Mawu ƒe aʋakɔ ene.
David ƒe asrafohawo
23Asrafoha siwo katã va David gbɔ le Xebron be yewoakpe ɖe eŋu wòazu fia ɖe Saul teƒe le Aƒetɔ ƒe nya nu la ƒe xexlẽmee nye: 24Ame siwo tso Yuda-to la me, ame siwo tsɔa akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ la ƒe xexlẽme le ame akpe ade alafa enyi. 25Kalẽtɔ siwo tso Simeon-to la me le ame akpe adrẽ alafa ɖeka. 26Levi-to la me tɔwo le ame akpe ene alafa ade. 27Ame siwo tso Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo dome la le ame akpe etɔ̃ alafa adrẽ, eye wo kplɔla nye Yoyada. 28Aʋakalẽtɔ Zadok, si nye ɖekakpui ko la kple eƒe ƒometɔwo le ame bla eve vɔ eve. 29Ame akpe etɔ̃ tso Benyamin-to la me nye Saul nɔviwo elabe le ɣe ma ɣi me la, wo dome akpa gãtɔ ganɔ Saul dzi. 30Ame akpe bla eve alafa enyi tso Efrayim-to la me. Wonye aʋakalẽtɔ xɔŋkɔwo le woƒe ƒomeawo me. 31Wotia ame akpe wui enyi tso Manase-to afã si le ɣetoɖoƒe la me be woayi aɖaɖo David fiae. 32Asrafomegã alafa eve kple wo nɔviwo tso Isaxar-to si nya ɣeyiɣi si Israel awɔ nu wòanyo la hã va. 33Ame akpe bla atɔ̃ tso Zebulon-to la me va aʋakɔ la me. Wonya aʋawɔnu vovovowo ŋudɔwɔwɔ, eye woɖoe kplikpaa be yewoanɔ David dzi. 34Aʋakplɔla akpe ɖeka kple woƒe asrafo akpe bla etɔ̃ vɔ adrẽ siwo tsɔa akpoxɔnu kple akplɔ la tso Naftali-to la me va. 35Ame siwo bla akpa na aʋawɔwɔ tso Dan-to la me la le ame akpe bla eve vɔ enyi alafa ade. 36Ame siwo tso Aser-to la me yi eye wole klalo na aʋawɔwɔ la de akpe bla ene. 37To siwo le Yordan ƒe ɣedzeƒe, Ruben, Gad kple Manase ƒe to afã, ƒe amewo le akpe alafa ɖeka bla eve. Aʋawɔnu vovovowo le wo si.
38Ame siawo katã bla akpa na aʋawɔwɔ. Wova Xebron kple tameɖoɖo kplikpaa be yewoaɖo David fiae ɖe Israel blibo la nu. Taɖodzinu ɖeka siae nɔ Israeltɔ bubuawo katã hã si. 39Wonɔ David gbɔ ŋkeke etɔ̃, ɖu nu, no nu elabe wo nɔviwo dzra ɖo ɖe wo ŋu nyuie. 40Azɔ ame siwo te ɖe wo ŋu ɖase Isaxar, Zebulon kple Naftali nutowo me la hã tsɔ nuɖuɖu vovovowo ɖe tedzi, kposɔ, tedzisɔ kple nyitsuwo dzi vɛ: Wotsɔ wɔ, gbotitsetsebolo, waintsetsebolo, wain, nyitsu kple alẽ geɖe hã vɛ elabe dzidzɔ nɔ Israel.

Title: KRONIKA I 13
Content:
Woɖakɔ nubablaɖaka la tso Kiryat-Yearim va Yerusalem
(Sam II, 6.1-11)
1David de adaŋu kple eƒe asrafomegã siwo nye akpewo kple alafawo ƒe kpɔlawo kpakple dumegã bubuawo katã. 2Azɔ egblɔ na Israel ƒe ameha blibo la be: “Ne enyo na mi, eye wònye Aƒetɔ, mia Mawu ƒe lɔlɔ̃nu la, ekema mina miadɔ ame ɖo ɖe mía nɔvi susɔeawo le Israel-nyigba blibo la dzi. Míaɖo ame ɖe nunɔlawo kple Levi viwo hã le woƒe du kple agbletawo be woava ƒo ƒu ɖe mía gbɔ. 3Míaɖakɔ mía Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ava mía gbɔe, elabe míebia eta le Saul ŋɔli kpɔ o.” 4Nya sia dze ameha bliboa ŋu, eya ta wolɔ̃ be yewoawɔ ɖe edzi.
5 Ale David ƒo ƒu Israel blibo la, tso Sixor le Egipte ɖase Xamat be woaɖakɔ nubablaɖaka la tso Kiryat-Yearim vɛ. 6 Tete David kple Israel bliboa yi Baala, si nye Kiryat-Yearim le Yuda, be woaɖakɔ Mawu Aƒetɔ, ame si nɔa kerubiwo tame le teƒe si wosubɔnɛ le la ƒe aɖaka la. 7Wotsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ɖo tasiaɖam yeye dzi tso Abinadab ƒeme, eye Uza kple Axyo le tasiaɖam la kplɔm. 8David kple Israel blibo la le ɣe ɖum le Mawu ŋkume kple woƒe ŋusẽ katã ɖe hadzidzi, saŋku, kasaŋku, asiʋui kple gakogoe kpakple kpẽwo ŋu.
9Esi wova ɖo Kidon ƒe lugbɔƒe la, Uza do asi ɖa be yealé aɖaka la elabe nyiawo kli nu. 10Tete Aƒetɔ do dziku ɖe Uza ŋu, eye woƒoe ƒu anyi elabe eka asi aɖaka la ŋu. Uza ku ɖe Mawu ŋkume le afi ma. 11Eve David be Aƒetɔ ɖe dziku ɖe Uza ŋu, eye woyɔa teƒe ma be Perez-Uza va se ɖe egbe. 12David vɔ̃ na Mawu gbe ma gbe eye wògblɔ be: “Ale ke matsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ava gbɔnyee?” 13Ale David metsɔ aɖaka la va eɖokui gbɔ le David ƒe du la me o, ke boŋ ena wokɔe yi Obed-Edom, Gat vi la ƒemee. 14Mawu ƒe aɖaka la tsi Obed-Edom ƒeme ɣleti etɔ̃, eye Aƒetɔ yra eƒe aƒe kple eƒe nuwo katã.

Title: KRONIKA I 14
Content:
David ƒe Yerusalem nɔnɔ
(Sam II, 5.11-16)
1Xiram Tiro- fia, dɔ ame ɖe David kple sedertiwo, xɔtulawo kple atikpalawo be woatu xɔ nɛ. 2Ale David dze sii be Aƒetɔ ye ɖo ye fiae ɖe Israel nu, elabe eƒe fiaɖuƒea de du le eƒe dukɔ Israel ta.
3David gaɖe srɔ̃ wo le Yerusalem eye wògadzi viŋutsu kple vinyɔnuwo fũu. 4Vi siwo wòdzi le Yerusalem la woe nye: Samua, Sobab, Natan, Salomo, 5Yibxar, Elisua, Elpelet 6Noga, Nefeg, Yafia, 7Elisama, Beelyada kple Elifelet.
David ɖu Filistitɔwo dzi
(Sam II, 5.17-25)
8Esi Filistitɔwo se be wosi ami na David wòzu fia ɖe Israel bliboa nu la, wo katã ho be yewoayi aɖadii. David see ale eya hã ho yi wo kpe ge. 9Azɔ la Filistitɔwo va kaka ɖe Refaim-bali la me le nu gblẽm. 10Tete David bia nu Mawu be: “Maho aʋa ɖe Filistitɔwo ŋua? Àtsɔ wo ade asi nama?” Aƒetɔ ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Ho yi, eye matsɔ wo ade asi na wò.” 11Ale woho yi Baal-Perazim, eye David si Filistitɔwo le afi ma. David gblɔ be: “Mawu to nye asi dzi dze nye futɔwo abe ale si tsiɖɔɖɔ gbãa goe ene!” Eya ta woyɔa teƒe ma be Baal-Perazim. 12Filistitɔwo gblẽ woƒe mawuwo ɖe afi ma eye David ɖe gbe wotɔ dzo wo.
13Filistitɔwo gava kaka ɖe balia me. 14David gabia nu Mawu, eye Mawu ɖo eŋu nɛ be: “Mègato wo yome o, ke boŋ trɔ naɖatso wo le klẽtiawo kasa. 15Ne èse afɔzi le klẽtiawo me ko la, ho aʋa elabe meho dze ŋgɔwò be maɖu Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ la dzi.” 16David wɔ ɖe Mawu ƒe gbe dzi eye wòɖu Filistitɔwo ƒe aʋakɔ la dzi tso Gibeon ɖase Gezer. 17David ŋkɔ ɖi de anyigbawo katã dzi, eye Aƒetɔ de vɔvɔ̃ dukɔwo katã me ɖe eŋu.

Title: KRONIKA I 15
Content:
Dzadzraɖo hena Nubablaɖaka la kɔkɔ
1David tu xɔwo na eɖokui ɖe David ƒe du la me, eye wòwɔ nɔƒe na Mawu ƒe aɖaka la hetu agbadɔ nɛ. 2 Emegbe ede se be: “Ame aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ akɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la o, negbe Levi viwo ko, elabe woawoe Aƒetɔ tia be woakɔe, eye woasubɔ ye tegbee.” 3David ƒo Israel blibo la nu ƒu ɖe Yerusalem, ne woaɖakɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aɖaka la ava teƒe si wodzra ɖo nɛ. 4Eƒo Aron ƒe dzidzimeviwo kple Levi viwo nu ƒu siwo nye: 5Kehat ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Uriel kple nɔviawo, ame alafa ɖeka bla eve. 6Merari ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Asaya kple nɔviawo, ame alafa eve bla eve. 7Gerson ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Yoel kple nɔviawo, ame alafa ɖeka bla etɔ̃. 8Elizafan ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Semaya kple nɔviawo, ame alafa eve. 9Xebron ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Eliel kple nɔviawo, ame bla enyi. 10Uziel ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔ Aminadab kple nɔviawo, ame alafa ɖeka wui eve. 11David yɔ nunɔlawo Zadok kple Abyatar kple Levi viwo, Uriel, Asaya, Yoel, Semaya, Eliel kple Aminadab, vɛ. 12Egblɔ na wo be: “Miawoe nye Levi ƒe dzidzimeviwo ƒe tatɔwo. Mi kple mia nɔviwo mikɔ̀ mia ɖokui ŋu, ne miaɖakɔ Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe aɖaka la va nɔƒe si medzra ɖo nɛ, 13elabe esi mienɔ anyi gbe ma gbe o tae Aƒetɔ, mía Mawu la do dziku ɖe mía ŋu le esi míebia gbee abe ale si dze ene o ta.” 14Ale nunɔlaawo kple Levi viawo kɔ̀ wo ɖokui ŋu be yewoaɖakɔ Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la ƒe aɖaka la vɛ. 15 Levi viwo tsɔ ati kɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ɖe abɔta abe ale si Aƒetɔ ɖo na wo to Mose dzi be woawɔe la ene.
16David gagblɔ na Levi viwo ƒe tatɔwo hã be woana wo teviwo natsɔ saŋkuwo, kasaŋkuwo kple gakogoewo, siwo nye hadzinuwo la anɔ dzidzɔhawo dzim bobobo. 17Tete Levi viwo ɖe Heman, Yoel vi, Asaf, Berexya vi kple Etam, Kusaya vi siwo nye Merari ƒe dzidzimeviwo tso wo nɔviwo dome. 18Wo nɔvi siwo le ɖoɖo evelia me kpe ɖe wo ŋu lae nye: Zaxarya, Yaaziel, Semiramot, Yexiel, Uni, Eliab, Benaya, Maaseya, Matitya, Elifelehu kple Mikneya. Hekpe ɖe ame siawo ŋu la, woɖe agbonudzɔla eve hã siwo nye Obed-Edom kple Yeiel. 19Heman, Asaf kple Etan nye hadzila siwo ƒoa akɔbligakogoe. 20Zaxarya, Aziel, Semiramot, Yexiel, Uni, Eliab, Maaseya kple Benaya nye kasaŋkuƒolawo. Woƒonɛ wòɖina ɖe nyɔnuwo ƒe gbe kɔkɔtɔ dzi. 21Ke Matitya, Elifelehu, Mikneya, Obed-Edom, Yeiel kple Azaz nye ame siwo tsɔa kasaŋku gbe bɔbɔetɔ doa ha ɖae. 22Wotsɔ Kenanya, Levi viwo ƒe tatɔ ɖo agbatsɔtsɔ nu elabe enya nu le agbatsɔtsɔ ŋu nyuie. 23Berexya kple Elkana nye aɖaka la ƒe agbonudzɔlawo. 24Nunɔlawo: Sebanya, Yosafat, Netaneel, Amasai, Zaxarya, Benaya kple Eliezer, nye kpẽkulawo le Mawu ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ. Obed-Edom kple Yexiya hã nye agbonudzɔlawo na aɖaka la.
Nubablaɖaka la kɔkɔ va Yerusalem
(Sam II, 6.12-22)
25Ale David kple Israel ƒe ame tsitsiwo kpakple kplɔla siwo kpɔa asrafo akpewo dzi la yi ɖakɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la tso Obed-Edom ƒeme vɛ kple dzidzɔ. 26Esi Mawu ve Levi viwo nu wokɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aɖaka la ta la, wotsɔ nyitsu adrẽ kple agbo adrẽ sa vɔe. 27David ŋutɔ, Levi vi siwo tsɔ aɖaka la, hadzilawo kple Kenanya, agbatsɔlawo ƒe tatɔ, wo katã wodo dziwui si wotsɔ aklala biɖibiɖi tɔe la eye David do aklala biɖibiɖi kɔmewu ɖe etɔ dzi. 28Ale Israel blibo la le aseye tsom, le kpẽ kple dze kum, le gakogoewo ƒom, eye wole saŋku kple kasaŋkuwo ƒom sesĩe hekɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la gbɔnae.
29Esi Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la va ɖo David ƒe dua me la, Mixal, Saul vinyɔnu do mo ɖa kpɔ David to fesre nu, wòle ɣe ɖum, le kpo tim, eye wòdo vloe le eƒe dzime.

Title: KRONIKA I 16
Content:
1Wotsɔ Mawu ƒe aɖaka la va dro ɖe agbadɔ si David tu nɛ la me, eye wosa numemevɔ kple ŋutifafavɔ le Mawu ŋkume. 2Esi David sa numemevɔ kple ŋutifafavɔ la vɔ la, eyra dukɔ la le Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ me, 3eye wòma abolo, ayedetsetsebolo kple waintsetsebolo ɖekaɖeka na Israelviwo dometɔ ɖe sia ɖe, ŋutsuwo kple nyɔnuwo siaa.
4David ɖe subɔlawo tso Levi viwo dome be woanɔ Aƒetɔ ƒe aɖaka la ŋgɔ, ayɔ Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la, ada akpe nɛ, eye woakafui. 5Asaf nye wo kplɔla, eye Zaxarya nye eƒe kpeɖeŋutɔ. Yeiel, Semiramot, Yexiel, Matitya, Eliab, Benaya, Obed-Edom kple Yeiel nye saŋku kple kasaŋkuƒolawo, eye Asaf ŋutɔ nye gakogoeƒola. 6Benaya kple Yexaziel nanɔ kpẽ kum enuenu le Mawu ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ. 7Gbe ma gbee nye zi gbãtɔ si David tsɔ akpedahadzidzi na Aƒetɔ ƒe dɔ de asi na Asaf kple nɔviawo.
Akpedaha
(Ps 105.1-15; 96.1-13; 106.1, 47-48)
8Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ, miyɔ eŋkɔ.
Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe dɔwɔwɔwo le dukɔwo dome.
9Midzi ha nɛ, midzi kafukafuha nɛ.
Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe nukudɔwo katã.
10Mitsɔ eŋkɔ kɔkɔe la ƒo adegbee.
Ame siwo katã dia Aƒetɔ la, nedzɔ dzi!
11Midi Aƒetɔ kple eƒe ŋusẽ,
midi eŋkume nɔnɔ enuenu.
12Miɖo ŋku nukunu siwo wòwɔ,
eƒe dzesiwo kple nyametsotso siwo do le enu la dzi.
13O, eƒe dɔla Israel ƒe dzidzimeviwo,
O, mi Yakob viwo,
mi eƒe ame tiatiawo.
14Eyae nye Aƒetɔ, míaƒe Mawu la,
eyae drɔ̃a ʋɔnu xexea me katã.
15Miɖo ŋku eƒe nubabla
kple nya si wògblɔ,
hena dzidzime akpewo la dzi tegbee.
16 Nu si wòbla kple Abraham
kple atam si wòka na Isak la,
17 etsɔe wɔ ɖoɖo na Yakob,
eye wòtsɔe wɔ nubabla na Israel tegbee hegblɔ be:
18“Wòe matsɔ Kanaan-nyigba ana,
ne wòanye miaƒe domenyinu.”
19Togbɔ be woƒe xexlẽme nɔ sue
womede naneke o,
eye wonye amedzrowo le anyigba la dzi,
20le tsatsam tso dukɔ me yi dukɔ me,
tso fiaɖuƒe ɖeka gbɔ yi dukɔ bubu gbɔ hã la,
21 meɖe mɔ ame aɖeke te wo ɖe anyi o.
Eka mo na fiawo gɔ̃ hã le wo ta.
22Ebe:
“Migaka asi nye amesiaminawo ŋu o,
eye migawɔ vɔ̃ aɖeke nye gbeƒãɖelawo o!”
23Anyigbawo katã, midzi ha na Aƒetɔ.
Miɖe gbeƒã eƒe xɔname, tso ŋkeke yi ŋkeke.
24Miƒo nu le eƒe ŋutikɔkɔe ŋu
le dukɔwo dome;
mixlẽ eƒe nukudɔwo fia
le anyigba dzi tɔwo katã dome.
25Elabe Aƒetɔ tri akɔ,
eye wòdze be woakafui geɖe ŋutɔ.
Vɔvɔ̃ le eŋu wu mawuwo katã.
26Elabe dukɔwo ƒe mawuwo katã la,
nu dzodzrowo ko wonye;
ke Aƒetɔ ye wɔ dziƒowo.
27Bubu kple atsyɔ̃ le eŋu,
ŋusẽ kple dzidzɔ le enɔƒe.
28Dukɔwo ƒe ƒomeawo katã,
mitsɔ bubu kple ŋusẽ na Aƒetɔ.
Ẽ, Aƒetɔ ye miatsɔe na!
29Mide bubu Aƒetɔ ŋkɔ ŋu,
miva eŋkume kple nunanawo!
Mitsɔ kɔkɔenyenye ɖo atsyɔ̃,
ne miasubɔ Aƒetɔ.
30Anyigba blibo la nedzo nyànyanya
le eŋkume,
xexea me li ke sesĩe;
maʋã gbeɖe o.
31Dziƒowo nekpɔ dzidzɔ, anyigba netso aseye,
eye woagblɔ le dukɔwo dome be,
“Aƒetɔ ye nye fia!”
32Atsiaƒu kple nu siwo katã le eme neɖe gbe,
agblewo kple wo me nuwo nedzɔ dzi.
33Azɔ avemetiwo adzi dzidzɔha le Aƒetɔ ŋkume,
elabe eva be yeadrɔ̃ ʋɔnu xexea me.
34 Mida akpe na Aƒetɔ,
elabe eƒe dɔme nyo,
eye eƒe amenuveve li tegbee.
35Migblɔ hã be:
“Mawu míaƒe Xɔnametɔ, ɖe mí loo!
Ƒo mía nu ƒu,
eye nàɖe mí le dukɔwo si me,
ne míada akpe na wò,
akafu wò ŋkɔ kɔkɔe la,
eye míaƒo adegbe be wòe míekafuna.
36Woakafu Aƒetɔ, Israel ƒe Mawu la,
tso mavɔ me yi mavɔ me!”
Tete dukɔ blibo la ɖo eŋu be: “Neva eme!”, eye wokafu Aƒetɔ.
Mawu subɔsubɔ le Yerusalem kple Gibeon
37David tsɔ Asaf kple nɔviawo ɖo Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka la ŋgɔ le afi ma, ne woasubɔ ɖe ɖoɖo si wowɔ na ŋkeke sia ŋkeke nu. 38Eɖo Obed-Edom, Yedutun vi kple nɔvia bla ade vɔ enyi kple Xosa be woanye agbonudzɔlawo. 39David gblẽ nunɔla Zadok kple nɔvia nunɔlawo ɖe Aƒetɔ ƒe nɔƒe si le vɔsaƒe si le Gibeon la nu, 40be woasa vɔ na Aƒetɔ le numemevɔsamlekpuia dzi ɖaa ŋdi kple fiẽ, abe ale si woŋlɔe ɖe se si Aƒetɔ de na Israel la me la ene. 41Hekpe ɖe ame siawo ŋu la, wogaɖe Heman kple Yedutun kpakple ame tɔxɛ bubu siwo dzi wotɔ asii la be woanɔ akpe dam na Aƒetɔ elabe eƒe amenuveve li tegbee. 42Wotsɔ kpẽwo, gakogoewo kple Mawu ƒe hadzinuwo na Heman kple Yedutun be woatsɔ na hadzilawo, eye Yedutun viwo nye agbonudzɔlawo.
43 Esiawo megbe la, ame sia ame dzo yi eƒeme, eye David hã trɔ yi ɖayra eƒemetɔwo.

Title: KRONIKA I 17
Content:
Natan xɔ gbedeasi vɛ na David
(Sam II, 7.1-17)
1Azɔ David le eƒe fiasã me. Egblɔ na gbeƒãɖela Natan be: “Kpɔ ɖa, nye la, mele sedertixɔ me; ke Aƒetɔ ƒe nubablaɖaka ya le avɔgbadɔ me.” 2Natan ɖo eŋu na David be: “Nu sia nu si le dzime na wò la, wɔe elabe Mawu li kpli wò.”
3Ke le gbe ma gbe ƒe zã me ke la, Mawu ƒe gbe va na Natan be: 4“Yi ɖagblɔ na nye dɔla David be, ‘Aƒetɔ be: Menye wòe atu xɔ nam manɔ eme o. 5Elabe tso gbe si gbe mekplɔ Israel dzoe va se ɖe egbe sia la, nyemenɔ xɔ me kpɔ o, ɖeko matso agbadɔ me ayi agbadɔ me, atso nɔƒe ayi nɔƒe. 6Menɔ kple Israel-dukɔa le afi sia afi. Ðe mebia Israel ɖela siwo metia be woanɔ nye dukɔa nu la dometɔ aɖe kpɔ be: ‘Nu ka tae mètu sedertixɔ nam o mahã?’ 7Eya ta gblɔ na nye dɔla David be: ‘Nye Aƒetɔ, Aʋakɔwokplɔla mebe, meyɔ wò tso lãnyiƒe le alẽwo yome be nàva zu dziɖula ɖe nye dukɔ Israel nu. 8Afi sia afi si nèyi la menɔ kpli wò, eye menyà wò futɔwo katã ɖa le ŋgɔwò. Mena nèxɔ ŋkɔ abe anyigba dzi fia gãwo ke ene. 9Mana nɔƒe nye dukɔ Israel, afi si wòanɔ aɖe dzi ɖi, eye ame aɖeke magaɖe fu na wo o, ame vɔ̃ɖiwo mage ɖe wo dome atsrɔ̃ wo abe tsã, 10esi meɖo ɖelawo na nye dukɔ Israel ene o. Mabɔbɔ wò futɔwo katã ɖe anyi. Gawu la, mele egblɔm na wò be Aƒetɔ le xɔ tu ge na wò. 11Ne wò agbenɔŋkekewo de be nàyi tɔgbuiwòwo gbɔ la, ekema maɖo wò dzidzimevi si tso wò ŋutɔ viwòwo dome la, yowòme, eye mana eƒe fiaɖuƒe nali ke. 12Eyae atu xɔ nam eye mana eƒe fiazikpui ali ke tegbee. 13 Manye tɔ́a, eye eya anye vinye. Nyemadzudzɔ enu veve abe ale si mewɔ ame si do ŋgɔ na wò la ene o, 14ke boŋ mana wòali ke ɖe nye aƒeme kple nye fiaɖuƒea nu tegbee, eye eƒe fiazikpui ali ke tegbee.’ ” 15Natan yi ɖagblɔ nya siawo katã kple ŋutega blibo la na David pɛpɛpɛ.
David do gbe ɖa da akpe na Mawu
(Sam II, 7.18-29)
16Tete David fia la, va bɔbɔ nɔ Aƒetɔ ŋkume, eye wògblɔ be: “O Aƒetɔ Mawu, ame kae menye eye nu kae nye nye ƒome la hafi nèkplɔm va ɖo teƒe sia gbegbe? 17Ke esia gɔ̃ hã la, nu tsɛ aɖe ko wònye na wò, O Mawu. Ègado nu si nàva wɔ na nye, wò dɔla sia ƒe ƒomea gbe aɖe gbe ƒe ŋugbe. O Aƒetɔ Mawu, èbum bubume gã aɖee. 18Wò ŋutɔ ènya nye wò dɔla. Nya ka nye David magagblɔ akpe ɖe bubu si nède ŋunye la ŋu? Elabe ènya wò dɔla nyuie. 19O Aƒetɔ, wò dzimedidi na nye, wò dɔla tae nèwɔ nu gã siawo ɖo, be nàtsɔ ɖe wò nu triakɔ wɔwɔwo katã afia. 20Aƒetɔ, le nu siwo katã míese kple míaƒe towo nu la, ame aɖeke mele abe wò ene o; wò ɖeka koe nye Mawu. 21Dukɔ bubu kae gale anyigba dzi abe wò dukɔ Israel, si wò Mawu nèɖaɖe tso Egipte be wòanye ye ŋutɔ ye tɔ la ene?
